name: Wall Rollout (Beginner)
steps: Roll towards a wall.
The wall serves as a stop block so that you don't go too far.
Ideal for learning the technique and slowly increasing your reach.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Bent Over Row
steps: Stand with soft knees and hinge forward keeping your back flat.
Pull the bar toward your belly button by moving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Barbell Bicep Curl
steps: Stand tall with upright posture.
Grip the barbell with an underhand supinated grip.
Bend your arms and lower or row the bar toward your chest.
Keep your elbows still next to your body (don't swing).
cues: Maintain an active, braced core and steady breathing cadence.
Focus on quality of movement and full range of motion.

name: Slider Hamstring Curls
steps: Lie on your back, heels on the sliders.
Lift your hips (bridge).
Slide your feet out until your legs are almost straight and then pull them back towards your buttocks with your hamstrings.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Slider Push Up Reach
steps: As you perform a push-up, slide straight forward with one hand (on a slider).
Press yourself up and retract your hand back to the starting stance.
Alternate with each repetition.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Scissors
steps: Start sideways with your lead foot inside the ladder rung and trail foot outside.
Jump and switch feet in the air (scissor motion).
Move sideways along the ladder while jumping.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Landmine Thruster
steps: Hold the bar in front of your chest with both hands.
Do a deep squat.
Come up explosively and immediately push the bar above your head (extended arms).
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Ab Wheel Isometric Hold
steps: Roll out to your end range just above the floor and hold the extended position statically for the prescribed duration.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Hop Scotch
steps: Jump into the box on one leg, then jump with both legs wide (outside the box).
Jump into the next box with the other leg.
1-2-1-2 rhythm.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Slider Arm Circles
steps: High plank, both hands on the sliders.
Glide across the floor in a circular motion with one hand while the other hand stabilizes you.
Switch arms.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Slider Side Plank Tuck
steps: Stand in a side plank on your elbow with your feet on a slider.
Pull your knees toward your chest and push them out while remaining in side plank.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Slider Plank Jacks
steps: High plank, both feet on the sliders.
Glide both feet wide out and back in at the same time.
Keep your upper body as still as possible.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Plank with Lateral Hand Tap
steps: High shelf.
Tap the ground with your left hand far to the left, back, then right.
Keep hips still.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Ab Wheel Mountain Climbers
steps: With feet in the ab wheel foot cradles, drive your knees alternately toward your chest in a mountain climber motion.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Good Morning
steps: Barbell placed securely across upper traps.
Keep your legs nearly straight with a soft bend at the knees.
Bend forward from your hips until your back is horizontal.
Maintain a perfectly flat, neutral spine.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Landmine Floor Press
steps: Lie on your back on the floor next to the bar.
Grip the end of the bar with one hand.
Press the barbell up to full extension, then lower until your elbow touches the floor.
cues: Maintain an active, braced core and steady breathing cadence.
Focus on quality of movement and full range of motion.

name: Landmine Hack Squat
steps: Turn your back to the landmine.
Rest the barbell across one shoulder.
Lean back against the bar and sink into a deep hack squat.
This insulates the front of the legs.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Landmine Lateral Lunge
steps: Hold the bar in front of your chest.
Step wide to the side and sink into a side lunge with opposite leg fully extended.
Push off powerfully to return to the center position.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Landmine Reverse Lunge
steps: Hold the bar in one hand (on the side of the leg that steps back) or with both hands in front of the chest.
Step backward into a reverse lunge and push back to start.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Landmine Shoulder-to-Shoulder Press
steps: Hold the bar with both hands at your left shoulder.
Press up through the center and lower the weight to your right shoulder.
Alternate continuously.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Landmine Single Leg RDL
steps: Balance on one single leg with your core engaged.
Hold the bar in the hand opposite your supporting leg.
Bend forward at your hip while stretching your free leg back.
Keep your back flat and neutral.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Landmine Squat (Goblet)
steps: Hold the end of the bar against your chest with both hands.
Place your feet shoulder width apart.
Descend into a squat leaning gently against the landmine bar.
Push yourself back up.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Smith Machine Hip Raise
steps: Position a bench in the rack and load the bar to an appropriate weight. Lie down on the bench, placing the bottom of your feet against the bar. Unlock the bar and extend your legs. You may need to use your hands to assist you. For added stability grasp the sides of the Smith Machine. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the movement by rotating your pelvis, flexing your spine to raise your hips off of the bench. Maintain a slight bend in the knees throughout the motion.
After a brief pause, return the hips to the bench.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Chest Push from 3 point stance
steps: Start in a three-point stance with one hand on the floor and a medicine ball in front.
Step forward, gathering the ball to your chest with both hands.
As your second foot plants, explosively thrust the ball straight forward with maximum velocity.
cues: Drive through your lower body to transfer ground force into the throw.
Follow through completely with arms and torso.

name: Kneeling Ab Rollout
steps: The basic exercise.
Sit on your knees, roll the wheel forward in a controlled manner until your body is almost straight and pull yourself back to the starting position using your abdominal muscles.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Standing Ab Rollout
steps: Start standing upright, hinge forward, and roll the ab wheel out until your body hovers fully extended above the floor.
Pull yourself back up to standing.
Very heavy and only for advanced users.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Ali Shuffle
steps: Stand in a sideways athletic stance.
Jump and switch your feet in the air (scissor motion).
One foot lands inside the ladder rung while the other lands outside.
Switch lead legs with each bound as you travel down the ladder.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Lateral High Knees
steps: Go sideways.
Lift your knees high and place two feet in each box as you move sideways.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Single Leg Hops
steps: Hop through the ladder on one leg.
Touch each box.
Keep contact time short and stay on the forefoot.
Do the return leg with the other leg.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Lateral In-In-Out-Out
steps: Stand behind the ladder in a wide athletic stance.
Step in with the left, step in with the right, step out backwards on the left, step out backwards on the right.
In the meantime, move sideways to the next box.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Lateral Plank Walk
steps: Position yourself in a forward position (board on your hands) next to the ladder.
Step hands laterally through the ladder rungs while feet trail alongside in a traveling plank.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Skiers (Slalom)
steps: Keep the feet together.
Jump zig-zagging through the ladder: left outside the box, in the box, right outside the box, in the box.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Backward Run (2-ins)
steps: Run backwards through the ladder.
Place two feet in each box.
Stay on your forefeet and lean forward slightly to avoid falling.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Place one foot behind you on the bench.
Rest the barbell across your upper traps.
Lower your front leg until your thigh is parallel to the ground.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Close Grip Bench Press
steps: Do a Bench Press, but grip the bar narrowly (hands shoulder width apart).
Keep your elbows tight to your body.
This mainly trains your triceps.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Pistol Squats
steps: Squat down on one leg with the opposite leg held straight out in front in a pistol squat.
Very heavy!
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

video.channel: Marie Steffen - The Art of Health

name: Plank
steps: Hold a low plank supporting your weight on forearms and toes.
Body like a plank.
Draw your navel toward your spine and engage your glutes.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Push Ups
steps: Place hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower until your chest almost touches the ground.
Body straight.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Reverse Lunges
steps: Step backward instead of forward into a reverse lunge.
Often better for the knees.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Russian Twist
steps: Sitting, feet loose.
Rotate upper body from left to right.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Side Lunges
steps: Take a wide lateral step and sink your weight into that leg.
The other leg remains straight.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Side Plank
steps: Support yourself on one elbow and the side of your feet.
Keep hips high.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Skaters
steps: Jump sideways from one leg to the other.
Cross the free leg from behind (like skating).
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Split Squats
steps: Stand in a split-stance lunge position.
Lower up and down without moving your feet.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Star Jumps
steps: Start small (squat).
Explosively lunge into an X-shape in the air.
Land softly to absorb impact through your knees and hips.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Superman
steps: See Back Extension.
Lie on your stomach, arms out in front.
Lift everything up and hold for a moment.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Tricep Dips
steps: Performed on a sturdy bench or chair.
Hands on the edge, buttocks just in front of it.
Dropping through the arms.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: V-Ups
steps: Lie stretched out.
Fold body in half (V-shape) and tap toes with hands.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Wall Sit
steps: Sit against the wall as if you were sitting on a chair (knees 90 degrees).
To cling!
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Wide Push Ups
steps: Place your hands wide.
Accentuates the chest muscles.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Sprinting
steps: Sprint at maximal effort across the target distance.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Plank Clocks
steps: Assume a solid plank position.
Walk hands or feet in a 360-degree circle like the hands of a clock.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Power Skip
steps: Perform powerful high-skips, driving your knee high, pumping your opposite arm, and jumping for maximum vertical height.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Tuck Jumps
steps: Jump up and pull your knees towards your chest as high as possible in the air.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Walkout to Push Up
steps: Perform as an Inchworm with an emphasis on a crisp push-up at full extension.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Push Up Rotation
steps: Perform a push-up, and as you press up, rotate your torso into a side plank reaching your top arm to the ceiling.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Reverse Crunches
steps: Lie on your back.
Pull knees to chest and lift buttocks slightly off the ground.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Superman Plank
steps: Plank where you place your hands far forward (elongated).
Very hard on the core.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Toe Touches
steps: Lie on your back, legs straight up.
Reach the hands towards the toes (crunch).
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Windshield Wipers
steps: Lie on your back, legs straight up.
Lower your legs together side-to-side like windshield wipers.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Plank Builders
steps: Follow the form guidelines for Commando Push-Ups.
Rotate and drive from a low position to a high finish.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Plank Leg Lifts
steps: From a plank position, lift one straight leg off the floor.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Plyo Lunges
steps: See Jumping Lunges.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Plyo Push Ups
steps: Perform an explosive push-up where your hands leave the floor to clap mid-air.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Prisoner Squats
steps: Perform bodyweight prisoner squats with hands clasped behind your head.
Forces a more upright and vertical spine.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Pulse Squats
steps: Descend into a deep squat and perform small, continuous pulsing reps at the bottom.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Scissor Kicks
steps: Lie on your back.
Legs stretched out crossed over each other.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Shoulder Taps
steps: High shelf.
Tap the opposite shoulder alternately while keeping your hips steady.
Hips still!
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Squat Kicks
steps: Squat and kick forward as you rise.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Standing Calf Raise
steps: See Calf Raises.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Lateral Hops (Over the Bosu)
steps: Place one foot on the convex side.
Bound laterally over the BOSU ball, switching feet mid-air to land softly on the dome.
Build speed using powerful lateral skating strides.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Shuttle Runs
steps: Sprint back and forth between two boundary lines (e.g.
10m apart).
Tap the ground with your hand at each line.
Quickly turn around and run back.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Slider Body Saw
steps: Assume a forearm plank position with your feet placed on sliding discs.
Slide your entire body back a few inches and then forward again.
Focus on keeping your lower back stable.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Slider Burpees
steps: Instead of jumping, slide your feet explosively back into a plank position, slide them right back under your chest and stand up.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Slider Knee Tucks
steps: Start in a high plank position with your toes centered on sliding discs.
Pull both knees toward your chest at the same time and then push them out in a controlled manner to the plank position.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Slider Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand up straight with one foot on a slider.
Glide that foot back into a lunge as your front leg bends to 90 degrees.
Pull your back foot firmly again.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Slider Single Leg Hamstring Curl
steps: Lie on your back, one heel on a slider, the other leg in the air.
Elevate your hips into a bridge and slide one heel out and back on a slider.
Extremely hard on the hamstrings.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Slider Spider Crawls
steps: Start in a high plank position with both feet on sliders.
Slide one knee to the outside of your elbow.
Alternate in a crawling motion.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Slider V-Sit Tuck
steps: Sit on your buttocks with your heels on the sliders.
Lean slightly back.
Tuck your knees toward your chest as you sit upright, then extend back out.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Dead Ball Pick Up Throw Downs
aliases: Dead Ball Pick Up Throw Downs
steps: Squat deeply to pick up the ball, extend and throw it back hard to the ground.
Keep your back flat and core braced when lifting from the floor to avoid rounding.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Dead Ball Push Press
steps: Hold the ball at chest height.
Bend your knees slightly and explosively throw the ball above your head.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Dead Ball Shoulder Throws
steps: Lift the ball from the ground and heave it backwards over your shoulder in one fluid motion.
Turn over and repeat (or switch shoulders).
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Dead Ball Squats
steps: Hold the ball (firmly) against the chest ('goblet' style) or on one shoulder.
Do deep squats.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Dead Ball Russian Twist
steps: Sit on the floor balancing on your sit bones with feet elevated.
Tap the ball on the ground to the left and right of your hips.
The ball is heavy, so do this in a controlled manner.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Burpee Slam
steps: Perform a powerful overhead ball slam.
Leave the ball on the floor, jump back into a plank burpee with hands on the ball, then jump feet back in.
Jump back, lift the ball and slam again.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Bent Over Row
steps: Hinge forward maintaining a flat back with hips pushed back.
Row the weights back toward your hips and lower ribs.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Bicep Curls
steps: Keep your elbows still at your sides.
Flex your elbows and curl the weights up toward your shoulders.
cues: Maintain an active, braced core and steady breathing cadence.
Focus on quality of movement and full range of motion.

name: DB Squats
steps: Hold the dumbbells at your sides (suitcase squat) or on your shoulders (front squat).
Sink down deeply into your knees.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Lunges
steps: Step out and drop your back knee toward the floor.
Hold the weights along your body.
Make sure the front knee does not slide far past the toes.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Man Makers
steps: Combination: Perform a push-up on dumbbells -> left arm row -> right arm row -> jump feet in -> squat clean into an overhead thruster.
An intense, highly demanding full-body conditioning exercise.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Renegade Row
steps: Start in a high plank position gripping dumbbells resting on the floor.
Row the weights alternately in a renegade row without letting your hips sway.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Thrusters
steps: Perform squats with weights loaded across your shoulders.
Come up explosively and immediately push the weights upwards (press).
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: DB Deadlift
steps: Hold the weights in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back, lowering the weights along your shins.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Farmers Walk
steps: Hold a heavy weight firmly in each hand.
Walk with small, quick steps.
Keep the torso stiff and upright (do not sway).
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Double Unders
steps: Jump up high once and twist the rope under your feet twice before landing.
Quickly rotate from your wrists.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Single Unders
steps: The basics of skipping ropes.
Keep your elbows at your sides, rotate at the wrists and make small jumps on the balls of your feet.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Boxer Step
steps: Shift your weight rhythmically from one foot to the other.
Lightly tap the ground (heel or toe) with your free foot each time.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
steps: Place the kettlebell between your feet.
Hinge at the hips with a neutral spine, grip the handle, and drive through your legs and hips to stand tall.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Kettlebell High Pull
steps: Start like a swing, but at the highest point pull the elbow high back.
The kettlebell floats for a moment.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Kettlebell Lunge Pass Through
steps: Do a lunge.
Pass the kettlebell under the front leg to the other hand.
Step back and alternate sides.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Kettlebell Press
steps: Start in the front rack position with the weight resting against your shoulder/chest.
Press the kettlebell straight overhead.
If necessary, rotate the wrist.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Kettlebell Row
steps: Hinge forward at the torso, optionally bracing against a bench or your knee.
Pull the kettlebell to the hip.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Kettlebell Snatch
steps: An advanced calisthenic movement requiring exceptional control.
Swing the kettlebell and snatch it overhead to full lockout in one fluid trajectory.
Catch the blow to the forearm gently.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Kettlebell Swing
steps: The basics.
Hinge from the hips (buttocks back, back straight).
Snap your hips explosively forward to propel the kettlebell to eye level in a Russian swing.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Turkish Get Up
steps: Lie on your back with the kettlebell raised.
Stand all the way up into full standing while keeping your arm locked vertically overhead.
Lie down again.
Technically complex!
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Figure 8 Squats
steps: Hold a low quarter-squat and weave the weight through your legs in a continuous figure-8.
Stay in the squat position consistently.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Kettlebell Z-Press
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Press the kettlebell(s) from shoulder height straight overhead.
Because you have no support from your legs, your core has to work extremely hard.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Slingshot (Around the Body)
steps: Stand tall with upright posture.
Pass the kettlebell around your body from one hand to the other.
Keep your hips locked in place while only your arms move.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Bear Crawl Drag
steps: Get into a crawling position (knees off the ground).
The kettlebell is underneath you.
Bear crawl forward while dragging the kettlebell along the floor with one hand.
Switch hands.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Kettlebell Bicep Curl
steps: Grip the kettlebell by the horns on the sides of the handle.
Curl the weight smoothly upward toward your chest.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
cues: Maintain an active, braced core and steady breathing cadence.
Focus on quality of movement and full range of motion.

name: Bottom-Up Press
steps: Hold the kettlebell upside down (bottom pointing toward the ceiling).
Balance it and gently push it up.
Requires strong grip and forearm endurance.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Clean and Press
steps: Clean the kettlebell or barbell up into the front rack position first.
Pause briefly in the rack position, then execute a strict overhead press.
Lower and repeat.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Deck Squat
steps: Drop into a deep squat, roll back onto your spine holding the kettlebell at your chest, then rock forward and stand up in one fluid motion.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Kettlebell Floor Press
steps: Lie on your back on the floor.
Push the kettlebell(s) up as with a bench press.
Lower until your elbows touch the floor, pause briefly, and press back up.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Glute Bridge (Weighted)
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent.
Place the kettlebell on your hips (hold with hands).
Drive your hips upward and squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
Hold on for a moment.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Gorilla Row
steps: Place two KBs between your feet.
Stand wide and bend forward with your knees bent (like a gorilla).
Press down on one kettlebell while rowing the other kettlebell to your ribcage.
Alternate sides continuously.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Lateral Lunge (Cossack)
steps: Hold the KB in front of the chest (goblet).
Step wide to the side, bending your knee into a lateral lunge while the other leg remains straight.
Keep your heel on the ground.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Overhead Carry
steps: Press the kettlebell overhead to full arm lockout.
Walk in a controlled manner and make sure your ribs do not stick out (core tight).
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Kettlebell Pullover
steps: Lie on your back (or on a bench).
Hold the kettlebell above your chest.
Lower the weight slowly behind your head with soft elbows in a pullover motion and pull back.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Kettlebell Push Press
steps: Start with the weight cleaned into the front rack position.
Dip quickly at the knees and use the leg drive to explosively thrust the kettlebell overhead.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Front Rack Carry
steps: Clean one or two kettlebells into the rack position against your chest.
Walk slowly while contracting your abdominal muscles and not leaning back.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Renegade Row
steps: Get into a high plank position with your hands on the handles of the kettlebells.
Alternately pull a kettlebell to your hip while trying to keep your hips still.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Single Arm Swing
steps: Same technique as the normal swing, but with one hand.
Use the free arm for balance and to prevent rotation of the torso (anti-rotation).
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Single Leg Deadlift (RDL)
steps: Balance on one single leg with your core engaged.
Hold the kettlebell in the opposite hand.
Tilt forward from your hip while stretching your free leg straight back.
Keep your back flat and neutral.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Sit-up and Press
steps: Lie on your back with the kettlebell on your chest.
Perform a full sit-up.
Once sitting upright, press the kettlebell smoothly overhead.
Lower down and roll back into the starting position.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Suitcase Deadlift
steps: Place the kettlebell next to one foot (outside).
Hinge down, grasp the handle, and drive up to standing.
Avoid pulling crookedly (stay straight).
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Tactical Lunge
steps: Step backward into a deep reverse lunge.
At the deepest point, pass the kettlebell under your front leg to the other hand.
Step back and repeat on the opposite leg.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Kettlebell Thruster
steps: Combine a deep squat with an explosive overhead press into a single fluid movement.
Lower yourself deeply into the squat and use the strength from your legs to push the kettlebell directly above your head.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Standing Tricep Extension
steps: Hold the kettlebell by the head or horns behind your head.
Extend your arms straight up toward the ceiling.
Keep your elbows close to your head.
cues: Maintain an active, braced core and steady breathing cadence.
Focus on quality of movement and full range of motion.

name: Kettlebell Windmill
steps: Extend the arm holding the kettlebell straight overhead.
Place your feet 45 degrees away from the arm.
Shift your hip to the side and slide your free hand down your leg toward the floor.
Look at the kettlebell.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Double Kettlebell Front Squat
steps: Clean two kettlebells to the rack position.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart and squat deeply.
Keep your elbows high so the weight doesn't pull forward.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Ball Chest Pass
steps: Throw the ball hard from the chest (with two hands) to a wall or partner.
Step forward with your lead leg to generate additional kinetic power.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Ball Push Ups
steps: Place one hand on the medicine ball and one on the floor, or both hands close together on the ball.
Perform a full range-of-motion push-up.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Ball Russian Twist
steps: Sit on the floor, feet slightly off the floor.
Hold the ball and rotate the torso from left to right.
Tap the ground if necessary.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Ball Slams
steps: Same as with the deadball, but be careful: some medicine balls bounce back hard!
Test your balance and range of motion cautiously before loading.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Woodchops
steps: Take a wide athletic stance.
Move the ball from high right to low left (diagonally) and rotate the torso and feet.
Switch sides and repeat.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Medicine Ball V-Up
steps: V-up with the ball in the hands.
Tap the toes with the ball.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Wall Balls
steps: Squat deeply with the medicine ball, explode upward, and throw the ball against the wall target.
Catch and squat immediately.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Overhead Power Throw
steps: Stand with your back facing an open lane.
Lower into a half squat and throw the ball far back over your head in one explosive movement.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Archer Pull Ups
steps: Take a very wide overhand grip on the bar.
Pull yourself up to your left hand while keeping your right arm extended.
Alternate sides with every rep.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Partner Squat Hold
steps: Lean back-to-back with your partner and descend into a shared squat hold.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Partner Back-to-Back Squat
steps: Stand back to back and link your arms.
Simultaneously lower yourself to 90 degrees (squat position) and push each other up again.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Wheelbarrow Push-up
steps: Partner A assumes a push-up position.
Partner B grasps Partner A's ankles and lifts them off the ground.
A does push-ups while B keeps the legs stable.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Leg Throws
steps: Partner A lies on their back holding the ankles of standing Partner B.
A raises the legs, B pushes them back forcefully.
A slows down and just misses the ground.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
steps: Sit on your knees.
Your partner anchors your ankles firmly to the floor.
Lower your torso forward with control, decelerating the descent using your hamstrings.
Press yourself back up to the top position.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Partner Towel Row
steps: Stand facing each other and hold one towel together.
Partner A rows the towel in toward their chest while Partner B provides manual resistance.
Alternate sides continuously.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Assisted Partner Pistol Squat
steps: Face your partner and lock right hands in a crossed grip.
Both partners descend into a right-leg pistol squat while holding hands for shared balance.
Switch legs.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Partner Russian Twist
steps: Sit back to back with your feet off the floor.
Pass a weight or ball to each other on the side.
Turn completely with your torso.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Partner Medball Chest Pass
steps: Stand facing each other 3 to 5 meters apart.
Using both hands, throw the medicine ball vigorously at your partner from the chest.
Step into the strike to maximize power generation.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Partner Rotational Throw
steps: Stand side by side (3m distance).
Throw the ball to the partner with a rotating movement (from the hip).
Partner catches and spins, and throws back.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Partner Plank Claps
steps: Plank opposite each other (head to head).
Clap each other's hands diagonally (Right taps Right).
Keep hips still.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Wall Ball Relay
steps: Partner A performs a wall ball shot.
Partner B catches the rebound, drops into a deep squat, and throws the ball back up against the target.
Keep alternating and rotating continuously.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Partner Pallof Press
steps: Stand side-by-side facing the same direction with a resistance band anchored between you.
Both hold it and push it forward.
The elastic wants to pull you together; resist this.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Partner Burpee Broad Jump
steps: Partner A performs a burpee.
While Partner A holds a plank or lies flat, Partner B performs a broad jump over them.
Swap partner roles or perform in a relay format.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Partner Decline Push-up
steps: Partner A holds a low plank or turtle crouch on hands and knees.
Partner B elevates their feet onto Partner A's back and performs decline push-ups.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Box Jumps
steps: Jump onto the box with both feet at the same time.
Fully extend the hips onto the box.
Step or hop down carefully.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Box Step Overs
steps: Step onto the box, turn, and step down on the opposite side.
Or step directly over the obstacle without rotating your torso.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Rest your rear foot laces-down on top of the plyo box in a Bulgarian split stance.
Lower through your front leg until your rear knee hovers just off the floor.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Dips
steps: Hands on the edge of the box, back close to the box.
Sink through the arms.
Stretched legs are heavier, bent legs are lighter.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Single Leg Step Up
steps: Step onto the box and drive upward explosively into a hop.
Switch legs or do one side first.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Chair Step Ups
steps: Step ups on a chair.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Decline Mountain Climbers
steps: Hands on the ground, feet on the box.
Pull your knees alternately toward your chest.
Heavier for shoulders and core.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Decline Push Ups
steps: Elevate your feet on the plyo box with hands on the floor in a decline plank.
This makes the push-up harder on the upper chest and shoulders.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Incline Push Ups
steps: Hands on the box, feet on the ground.
This makes the push-up lighter.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

video.channel: In The O Zone @ Coach O Athletics

name: Band Push Press
steps: Maintain a soft, slight bend in your knees.
Extend the legs explosively (as if you are going to jump) and use that force to push the handles of the band above the head.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Face Pulls
steps: More challenging than a normal row.
Pull the band toward your nose and eyes with elbows held high and flared in a face pull.
Excellent alternative if you only have light tires.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Half Kneeling Lift
steps: Use a low anchor point.
Raise the band diagonally across your body in a woodchopper pattern.
Focus on rotation from the chest, not the lower back.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Monster Walks
steps: Place the band around the ankles (or knees).
Walk wide and low (in squat position) forward or sideways.
Keep continuous tension on the resistance band throughout the movement.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: No Money
steps: Keep your elbows at your sides and your forearms squarely forward.
Turn the hands outward (external rotation).
Good for the shoulders and posture.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Resisted Push Ups
steps: Pass the band behind the back and hold the ends under your hands.
Push yourself up against the resistance of the band.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Single Arm Band Row
steps: Perform standing single-arm rows.
Maintain a stable position and pull the elbow back along the body.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Tricep Pushdown
steps: Attach the band high.
Grip the bar/handles and press downward by fully extending your elbows.
Keep the upper arms still at your sides.
cues: Maintain an active, braced core and steady breathing cadence.
Focus on quality of movement and full range of motion.

video.channel: Queens University of Charlotte Sports Performance

name: X Band Walks
steps: Stand on the resistance band and cross the handles in front of you into an X-shape.
Shuffle laterally across the floor.
Make sure your toes continue to point straight ahead.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Band Bicep Curls
steps: Stand on the resistance band to anchor it underfoot.
Grasp the band ends and curl upward toward your shoulders.
cues: Maintain an active, braced core and steady breathing cadence.
Focus on quality of movement and full range of motion.

name: Band Pull Aparts
steps: Hold elastic in front of you with arms straight.
Pull the band apart horizontally until it contacts your chest in a band pull-apart.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Sandbag Clean
steps: Lift the sandbag from the floor to your chest into a bear hug or front rack hold.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Sandbag Run
steps: Sprint forward carrying the sandbag on your shoulder or hugged to your chest.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Sandbag Squat
steps: Perform squats carrying the sandbag.
The unstable load makes it harder on the core.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Tyre Incline Push Up
steps: Hands on the belt, feet on the ground.
Perform a full range-of-motion push-up.
Slightly lighter than on the ground.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Tyre Tricep Dips
steps: Sit on the edge of the band, hands next to your hips.
Shift your hips forward off the support and lower down by bending your arms.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Tyre Step Ups
steps: Step one foot onto the tire and drive upward.
Alternate legs or complete all reps on one side before switching.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Tyre Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Place one foot behind you onto the treadmill belt.
Lower your front leg.
Keep your back flat and neutral.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Decline Mountain Climbers
steps: Elevate feet on the treadmill belt or tire with hands on the floor.
Pull your knees alternately toward your chest.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Incline Mountain Climbers
steps: Hands on the belt, feet on the ground.
Draw knees to chest.
Slightly lighter than decline.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Tyre Pop Squats
steps: Jump onto the band with both feet and land in a squat.
Jump back to the ground with feet wide.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: TRX Row
steps: Hang back on the handles.
Pull yourself up until your hands are at your chest.
Maintain a rigid plank line through your entire torso and legs.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: TRX Y-Fly
steps: Start leaning back in a row position with arms fully extended.
Pull yourself upward into a suspended Y-fly with arms raised diagonally overhead.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: TRX Knee Tuck
steps: Place your feet in the suspension cradles and hands on the floor in a plank.
Drive both knees in toward your chest.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Ab Wheel Knee Tucks
steps: Place your feet into the wheel foot cradles or foot straps.
From a plank position, pull your knees toward your chest.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: V-Rollout
steps: Start on your knees and roll the wheel out diagonally, alternating between left and right in a 'V' shape.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Ab Wheel Pikes
steps: With feet on the ab wheel, keep legs straight and drive hips high into a sharp pike V-shape.
Roll back to plank in a controlled manner.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Oblique Rollout
steps: Do not roll straight forward from your knees, but at an angle to the left and on the next repetition to the right.
This places direct emphasis on the oblique abdominal muscles.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Ab Wheel Plank
steps: Assume a plank position with your hands on the handles of the wheel instead of on the ground.
The instability of the wheel makes the board much heavier.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Single Arm Rollout
steps: Hold the wheel with only one hand as you roll out.
Use your other arm for balance or keep it behind your back.
Extremely heavy duty for anti-rotation.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Ab Wheel Inchworm
steps: Start standing, roll the wheel out into a full stretch, then walk your feet forward toward the wheel keeping hips high in an inchworm.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Carioca / Crossover
steps: Move sideways.
Cross your back leg alternately in front of and behind your front leg in the boxes.
Rotate your hips smoothly.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Hip Twist
steps: Jump into the box with both feet while rotating your hips so that your feet land at an angle.
Jump to the next square and rotate your hips the other way.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Agility Ladder Icky Shuffle
steps: Follow a continuous 3-count footwork rhythm.
Step one foot in the ladder rung (1), trail foot in (2), lead foot out (3) in an Icky Shuffle rhythm.
Move forward diagonally.
In-In-Out, In-In-Out.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: River Dance
steps: A variation on the Icky Shuffle.
Jump and tap the ground in the box with your heel, while crossing your other leg behind it.
Requires refined cadence and rhythm.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Icky Shuffle Backward
steps: Same pattern as the Icky Shuffle (in-in-out), but perform it backwards.
Demands spatial awareness and rhythm.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Agility Ladder In Out (Straddle Hops)
aliases: Agility Ladder In Out Straddle Hops
steps: Jump into the box with two feet at a time, then jump wide (outside the ladder) with two feet at a time.
Go directly to the next box.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Lateral Shuffle
steps: Stand sideways.
Step both feet rapidly into each ladder rung (lead foot first, trail foot follows).
Keep your hips low and look forward.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Centipede
steps: Perform rapid in-in-out-out ladder footwork focusing on micro-steps while keeping your center of mass over the ladder.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: High Knees (1-in)
steps: Run through the ladder with one foot per space.
Explosively pull your knees up to hip height.
Maintain an upright torso.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Snake Drill
steps: Jump sideways in and out of the ladder in a slalom motion.
Jump into the box, jump out on the side, jump diagonally to the next box.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Two-Foot Run (2-ins)
steps: Sprint straight forward through the agility ladder rungs.
Place two feet in each box (left-right, left-right).
Focus on maximum frequency and arm engagement.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Sumo Deadlift
steps: Place your feet very wide (wider than shoulders).
Take a narrow grip on the bar positioned between your legs.
Keep your back flat and drive through your legs to lift the barbell.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Back Squat
steps: Place the bar on your neck (on your trapezius).
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Bend your knees and hips as if you were going to sit down.
Keep your spine neutral as you drive back up to standing.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Bench Press
steps: Lie down on the couch.
Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower the barbell under control down to the midpoint of your chest.
Push out forcefully until your arms are straight.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Incline Bench Press
steps: Place the bench at an angle (approx.
30-45 degrees).
Execute the bench press with proper form.
This puts more emphasis on the top of your pecs.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Front Squat
steps: Rest the barbell across your anterior deltoids in a front rack position with elbows kept high.
Drop straight down.
This requires more balance and core stability than the Back Squat.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Landmine Single Arm Row
steps: Stand beside the barbell.
Hinge forward at your hips with a flat back.
Grip the barbell sleeve close to the weight plates.
Pull your elbow up and back.
Lower smoothly back to the starting position.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
steps: Hold the barbell with straight, extended arms.
Bend your knees slightly and push your hips far back as you lower the bar down your legs.
Feel the loaded eccentric stretch through your hamstrings.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Barbell Lunges
steps: Rest the barbell across your upper traps.
Step out with one leg and bend your knees until your back knee almost touches the ground.
Step back and switch legs.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Skull Crushers (Triceps Extension)
steps: Lie on the bench.
Hold the bar above your chest.
Bend only your elbows and lower the bar towards your forehead.
Extend your arms back out to the starting position.
cues: Maintain an active, braced core and steady breathing cadence.
Focus on quality of movement and full range of motion.

name: Upright Row
steps: Stand tall with upright posture.
Take a close grip on the barbell in front of your hips.
Pull the bar straight up along your body to under your chin.
Elbows flare outward and lead the pull upward.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Landmine Twist (Rotations)
steps: Hold the bar with both hands at eye level (arms slightly bent).
With your torso controlled, rotate the bar to your left hip, back to center, and then to your right hip.
Keep your hips as still as possible.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Landmine T-Bar Row
steps: Stand astride the bar.
Use a V-handle (or grab the bar directly).
Hinge forward with a flat, neutral spine.
Row the barbell in toward your lower ribcage/navel.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Landmine 180s (Rainbows)
steps: Hold the bar above your head with your arms straight.
Turn your entire body and swing the bar in a wide arc toward your left hip.
Turn through the arch (rainbow) towards your right hip.
Turn your feet.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Landmine Clean & Press
steps: Start with the barbell at hang height.
Pull it explosively up to your shoulder (clean) and immediately push it upwards (press).
Switch arms.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Landmine Meadows Row
steps: Stand perpendicular to the bar with one leg in front.
Grip the thick barbell sleeve with an overhand grip.
Pull your elbow wide and high to emphasize the upper back and rear delts.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Deadlift (Conventional)
steps: Stand with your shins directly against the barbell.
Grip the barbell, drop your hips, and lock in a flat back.
Lift the bar by straightening your legs and pushing your hips forward.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Overhead Press (Military Press)
steps: Stand tall with upright posture.
Hold the bar at chest height.
Press the barbell straight overhead to full lockout.
Tighten your abdominal muscles and don't lean too far back.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Push Press
steps: Same starting position as Overhead Press.
Bend your knees slightly (dip) and use that impulse to push the bar explosively above your head.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your shoulder blades resting against a flat bench and a padded loaded barbell across your hips.
Drive through your heels to bridge your hips upward until thighs and torso are parallel to the ground.
Lock out hips fully at the top and squeeze your glutes before lowering with control.
cues: Keep your chin tucked and eyes focused forward throughout the thrust.
Ensure knees track out over the toes at roughly a 90-degree angle at peak lockout.

name: Anti-Gravity Press
steps: Place a bar on the ground behind the head of an incline bench.
Lay on the bench face down. With a pronated grip, pick the barbell up from the floor. Flex the elbows, performing a reverse curl to bring the bar near your chest. This will be your starting position.
To begin, press the barbell out in front of your head by extending your elbows. Keep your arms parallel to the ground throughout the movement.
Return to the starting position and repeat to complete the set.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and keep your upper back braced.
Do not allow the bar to dip below parallel during extension.

name: Clean and Jerk
steps: Pull the barbell explosively from the floor and catch it in a front squat rack position.
Stand up fully from the squat to finish the clean phase.
Dip at the knees and drive upward powerfully to jerk the barbell overhead, splitting the feet to catch under lockout.
Recover feet to parallel before lowering the bar.
cues: Keep the barbell path tight to your body on both pulls.
Lock out overhead aggressively before recovering stance.

name: Clean Deadlift
steps: Stand with barbell close to shins using a clean width hook grip.
Keep shoulders slightly in front of the bar and back straight.
Drive through the floor maintaining constant back angle until the bar clears the knees, then extend hips into the bar.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Maintain bar contact against the legs throughout the pull.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
steps: Sit on the ground with a loaded barbell over your legs and roll it directly above your hips.
Lay flat on the floor with knees bent and feet placed firmly at shoulder width.
Drive through your heels to extend your hips vertically through the bar until hips are fully locked out.
Pause and squeeze your glutes hard at the top before lowering under control.
cues: Keep ribs pulled down and avoid hyperextending through the lumbar spine.
Drive through the midfoot and heels without rising onto your toes.

name: Barbell Guillotine Bench Press
steps: Lie flat on a bench, unrack the barbell with a medium grip, holding it locked out directly over your neck.
Inhale and lower the barbell slowly until it hovers roughly 1 inch from your neck or clavicles with elbows flared out wide.
Pause briefly, then press the bar back up to starting lockout using chest contraction.
cues: Use moderate, strictly controllable weights due to high shoulder abduction.
Lower the bar under extreme eccentric control.

name: Barbell Incline Shoulder Raise
steps: Lie back on an incline bench and hold a barbell overhead with arms straight and elbows locked.
Without bending your elbows, push the barbell upward purely by protracting your shoulder blades off the bench.
Lower your shoulder blades back into the bench with control and repeat.
cues: Keep arms completely straight; movement occurs exclusively at the scapulae.
Exhale on upward protraction and inhale on retraction.

name: Barbell Rear Delt Row
steps: Hold a barbell with a wide overhand grip and hinge forward until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Flare your elbows wide out to the sides perpendicular to your torso.
Row the barbell upward toward your upper chest, squeezing the rear deltoids firmly.
Slowly lower back down to full arm extension.
cues: Drive with the elbows out wide rather than tucking them into your lats.
Do not allow your torso to bob or swing up and down.

name: Barbell Seated Calf Raise
steps: Sit on a flat bench with the balls of your feet on an elevated calf block and a barbell resting across your lower thighs.
Lower your heels as far as comfortable to stretch the calves.
Drive upward onto your toes as high as possible, squeezing the soleus muscle hard.
Pause briefly and return smoothly to the bottom stretch.
cues: Use a bar pad or towel over thighs to minimize pressure discomfort.
Perform full range of motion without rapid bouncing.

name: Barbell Side Bend
steps: Stand upright with feet shoulder width apart and a light barbell resting across your upper back.
Keeping head up and back straight, bend strictly at the waist to the right side as far as comfortable.
Contract your obliques to return to upright position, then repeat to the left side.
cues: Move purely in the frontal plane without twisting or leaning forward.
Keep your lower body and hips completely stationary.

name: Barbell Side Split Squat
steps: Hold a barbell across upper traps and take a wide stance with lead foot angled out to the side.
Lower your body toward the angled foot by bending the knee and hip while trailing leg remains straight.
Extend through lead hip and knee to return to the starting position.
cues: Keep your chest upright and maintain heel contact with the floor.
Ensure the working knee tracks in line with the turned-out foot.

name: Bent-Arm Barbell Pullover
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding a barbell above your chest with shoulder-width grip and elbows bent.
Keeping the bend in your elbows locked in place, lower the bar back in an arc behind your head until you feel a deep stretch in lats and chest.
Pull the barbell back along the same arc to the starting position over your chest as you exhale.
cues: Keep elbows fixed at the set angle; do not turn the move into a triceps extension.
Brace your core to keep ribs from flaring excessively.

name: Board Press
steps: Lie flat on the bench with wooden boards held over your chest.
Unrack the bar and maintain a tight arch with shoulder blades retracted.
Lower the bar under control until it touches the boards, pausing momentarily.
Explosively press the barbell upward to full elbow lockout.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Do not bounce the bar off the boards.

name: Bradford / Rocky Presses
steps: Hold barbell at shoulder level with an overhand grip.
Press the bar just high enough to clear your head, lowering it behind the neck.
Immediately press it back over your head to the front collarbone to complete one repetition.
cues: Keep elbows directly under the wrists throughout transitions.
Do not lock out elbows at the top; keep continuous tension on deltoids.

name: Car Drivers (Plate Steering)
steps: Stand upright holding a weight plate at 9 and 3 o'clock positions with arms extended straight in front at shoulder height.
Rotate the plate smoothly to one side as if turning a steering wheel to full lock.
Reverse and rotate the plate all the way to the opposite side in continuous motion.
cues: Keep arms straight and elevated at shoulder level throughout the set.
Avoid leaning or swaying the torso while turning the plate.

name: Clean Pull
steps: Start with barbell over midfoot with an overhand or hook grip, back arched and chest tall.
Drive through your heels to pull the bar past knees while maintaining constant back angle.
As the bar passes mid-thigh, explosively extend through hips, knees, and ankles into a violent upward shrug.
Lower the barbell under control back to the floor.
cues: Keep arms straight and elbows pointed out; extension comes purely from lower body power.
Maintain close barbell proximity to thighs throughout second pull.

video.channel: CrossFit Monarch X Functional strength training

name: Clean Shrug
steps: Hold a barbell at mid-thigh with a shoulder-width clean grip and torso inclined slightly forward.
Explosively extend hips and shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Control the barbell back to the hanging position above knees and repeat.
