name: Hollow Hold
steps: 'Banana'.
Lie on your back, arms and legs extended off the ground.
Your lower back MUST maintain firm contact with the floor throughout.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.

name: Hollow Rock

cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.

name: Jumping Lunges
steps: Lunge down, jump explosively into the air, and switch legs mid-flight before landing softly.
Land softly in a deep lunge stance.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.

name: Jumping Squats
steps: See Jump Squats.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.

cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.

Focus on pure triceps isolation.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.

name: Mountain Climbers

Drive your knees rapidly toward your chest in an alternating pattern.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Spiderman Push Ups
steps: As you lower into the push-up, drive one knee out to the side toward your elbow in a Spiderman push-up.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Calf Jumps
steps: Jumping purely from the ankles (little knee bend).
Perform rhythmic jump rope skips without an actual rope (shadow jumping).
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: One Arm Push Up
steps: Perform a single-arm push-up with feet spread wide.
Very advanced.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Plank Jacks
steps: In plank position (hands or elbows).
Jump with your feet wide and narrow again.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Sit Ups
steps: Lie on your back, feet flat.
Raise your entire upper body to a sitting position.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Walking Lunges
steps: Perform walking lunges advancing forward across the floor.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Pike Push Up
steps: Hands and feet on the ground, buttocks high in the air (V-shape).
Bend the arms and bring the head to the ground (shoulders).
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Swing Lunges
steps: Lunge forward, then step directly back into a reverse lunge with the same leg in a pendulum motion.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Warrior Lunges
steps: Lunge forward while keeping both arms extended overhead.
Can also be done with sideways reaching.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Plank Hip Dips
steps: Hold an elbow plank position resting on your forearms.
Rotate and dip your hips side-to-side toward the floor.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

video.channel: Lotus Spine: Chiropractic and Sports Rehab

name: Reverse Snow Angels
steps: Lie on your stomach.
Swing arms straight from hips to overhead (without touching the ground).
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Single leg glute bridge.
Other leg in the air.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: T-Push Ups
steps: See Push Up Rotation.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Plank Up Downs
steps: Start in a high plank position on your hands.
One by one, lower yourself to your elbows (low plank) and push yourself back up to your hands.
Keep your hips completely stable without rotating.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Broad Jumps
steps: Long jump from a standstill.
Land on two feet and bend your knees.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Burpee Double Squat
steps: Do a burpee, but after the jump/landing add two squats before doing the next burpee.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Commando Push Ups
steps: From low plank (elbows) to high plank (hands) and back.
Alternate the pushing arm with each repetition.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Curtsy Lunges
steps: Step diagonally behind your front leg in a curtsy lunge.
Good for the side of the buttocks.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Frog Jumps
steps: Tap the ground into a wide squat and jump up (hands in the air).
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Frog Pumps
steps: Glute bridge with soles of feet together.
Fast pumping.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Hand Release Push Ups
steps: Drop to the ground.
Lift your hands briefly off the floor at the bottom of the push-up.
Put them down and push out.
Guarantees full range of motion.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Inchworm
steps: From standing -> place hands on floor -> walk hands out to plank -> (optional push-up) -> walk hands back to feet and stand.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Jumping Jacks
steps: The classic.
Jump legs wide, arms up.
Jump back.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Knee to Elbow
steps: Perform in either a plank position or hanging from a pull-up bar.
Bring knee to elbow.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Flutter Kicks
steps: Lie on your back, hands under your buttocks.
Legs extended slightly off the ground and make small kicking movements.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: 3/4 Sit-Up
steps: Lie down on the floor and secure your feet. Your legs should be bent at the knees.
Place your hands behind or to the side of your head. You will begin with your back on the ground. This will be your starting position.
Flex your hips and spine to raise your torso toward your knees.
At the top of the contraction your torso should be perpendicular to the ground. Reverse the motion, going only ¾ of the way down.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: 90/90 Hamstring
steps: Lie on your back, with one leg extended straight out.
With the other leg, bend the hip and knee to 90 degrees. You may brace your leg with your hands if necessary. This will be your starting position.
Extend your leg straight into the air, pausing briefly at the top. Return the leg to the starting position.
Repeat for 10-20 repetitions, and then switch to the other leg.
cues: Maintain a neutral spine flat against the floor.
Move smoothly without yanking into extreme knee extension.

name: All Fours Quad Stretch
steps: Start off on your hands and knees, then lift your leg off the floor and hold the foot with your hand.
Use your hand to hold the foot or ankle, keeping the knee fully flexed, stretching the quadriceps and hip flexors.
Focus on extending your hips, thrusting them towards the floor. Hold for 10-20 seconds and then switch sides.
cues: Avoid hyper-extending the lumbar spine.
Gently squeeze the glute of the stretching side to deepen hip extension.

name: Alternate Heel Touchers
steps: Lie on the floor with knees bent and feet flat, about 18-24 inches apart. Arms extended by your sides.
Crunch slightly forward and touch your right heel as you exhale.
Return smoothly and repeat to the left side, alternating reps continuously.
cues: Keep your shoulder blades elevated off the floor throughout.
Initiate lateral bend strictly from the obliques.

name: Cross-Body Crunch
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor, hands behind head.
Curl up diagonally, bringing right shoulder and elbow across toward left knee.
Lower and repeat toward the opposite knee, alternating sides.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back with arms reaching toward ceiling and knees/hips at 90 degrees.
Flatten your lower back firmly against the floor.
Slowly extend opposite arm and opposite leg toward the floor without allowing the lower back to arch.
Return to center and repeat on other side.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Maintain unbroken lumbar contact with the ground.

name: Bent-Knee Hip Raise
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent at a 75-degree angle and feet hovered 2 inches off the ground.
Using your lower abdominals, bring your knees toward your chest while rolling your pelvis backward off the floor.
Pause and squeeze your abs at peak contraction, then slowly lower hips back down without feet touching the floor.
cues: Initiate movement from abdominal contraction rather than swinging legs.
Lower under steady control without slamming the pelvis back down.

name: Body Tricep Press
steps: Position a bar in a rack at chest height.
Take an overhand grip, step backward with feet together, leaning into the bar with straight arms.
Flex elbows to lower your head beneath the bar in a skull-crusher movement.
Extend elbows forcefully to push your body back to the starting angle.
cues: Maintain a rigid plank line through torso and hips.
Keep elbows pointing forward rather than flaring out.

name: Butt-Ups (Pike Plank)
steps: Assume a forearm plank position with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Raise your glutes upward toward the ceiling, contracting abs to pull your hips into a pike position.
Slowly lower hips back down into a flat forearm plank without sagging.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Carioca Quick Step
steps: Stand in an athletic stance moving laterally.
Step trailing leg behind the lead leg, then step lead foot out laterally.
Cross trailing leg over the front with a high knee drive, pumping arms across the torso.
Continue moving sideways quickly, then reverse direction.
cues: Keep shoulders facing forward while hips rotate dynamically.
Stay light on the balls of the feet with quick ground contact times.

name: Clock Push-Up
steps: Assume a standard push-up plank position on hands and toes.
Lower chest toward the ground, then press up explosively until hands leave the floor.
Shift your body laterally 30 degrees to the side in mid-air (like clock hands) before landing.
Continue push-ups moving around in a full 360-degree circle.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Land with soft elbows to safely absorb plyometric impact.

name: Cocoons
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms extended overhead on the floor.
Tuck your knees toward your chest while lifting glutes off the floor.
Simultaneously crunch your torso upward and sweep your arms over knees.
Pause at peak cocoon tuck, then slowly extend back out to full length.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Crossover Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot diagonally back behind and across the front leg into a crossover curtsy lunge.
Bend both knees to lower hips until front thigh is parallel to the ground.
Drive through the front heel to return to center and repeat on opposite side.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure front knee tracks directly in line with front toes without caving in.

name: Decline Oblique Crunch
steps: Secure legs in a decline bench and recline until torso is slightly above the bench surface.
Place hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your torso upward while rotating to drive one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Hold the peak contraction for one second, lower slowly, and complete reps before switching sides.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Twist from the ribcage and obliques rather than wrenching with your neck.

name: Double Leg Butt Kick
steps: Stand tall with knees slightly bent.
Dip into a shallow squat and explode upward for maximum vertical height.
In mid-air, flex both knees rapidly to kick both heels up to touch the glutes.
Extend legs quickly to land softly on the balls of your feet.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Land with soft knees to absorb landing force smoothly.

name: Elbow to Knee Crunch
steps: Lie on the floor and cross your right ankle over your bent left knee.
Place hands lightly behind your head.
Flex your spine and rotate your torso diagonally to drive your left elbow toward your right knee.
Lower under control, complete prescribed reps, then switch sides.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Lead with the shoulder rather than pulling your head with your neck.

name: Flat Bench Leg Pull-In
steps: Sit on the edge of a flat bench holding the sides, legs extended off the end.
Pull knees in toward your chest as you exhale and lean slightly forward.
Pause to squeeze lower abdominals, then slowly extend legs straight back out without touching the floor.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Control the movement smoothly without using leg swinging momentum.

name: Flat Bench Lying Leg Raise
steps: Lie flat on a bench with legs extended off the end, gripping the bench beside your hips.
Keeping legs straight with knees soft, raise legs upward until they form a 90-degree angle with the torso.
Hold the contraction at the top for a second, then lower legs slowly back to horizontal.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Keep lumbar spine pressed firmly down against the bench surface.

name: Glute Kickback
steps: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Keeping the knee bent at 90 degrees, kick one leg upward until the thigh is parallel to the floor.
Squeeze the glute hard at peak height, then lower knee back to start and alternate or repeat.
cues: Do not arch or twist your lower back; isolate movement purely in the hip.
Drive through the heel upward toward the ceiling.

name: Groiners
steps: Begin in a high push-up plank position on hands and toes.
Jump forward with both feet, landing them wide outside your hands while keeping head up.
Immediately jump feet back to the plank position and repeat dynamically.
cues: Keep hands planted firmly and chest lifted when feet land wide.
Land lightly on the balls of your feet.

name: Crunches
steps: Lie flat on your back with your feet flat on the ground, or resting on a bench with your knees bent at a 90 degree angle. If you are resting your feet on a bench, place them three to four inches apart and point your toes inward so they touch.
Now place your hands lightly on either side of your head keeping your elbows in. Tip: Don't lock your fingers behind your head.
While pushing the small of your back down in the floor to better isolate your abdominal muscles, begin to roll your shoulders off the floor.

Continue to push down as hard as you can with your lower back as you contract your abdominals and exhale. Your shoulders should come up off the floor only about four inches, and your lower back should remain on the floor. At the top of the movement, contract your abdominals hard and keep the contraction for a second. Tip: Focus on slow, controlled movement - don't cheat yourself by using momentum.
After the one second contraction, begin to come down slowly again to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Decline Crunch
steps: Secure your legs at the end of the decline bench and lie down.
Now place your hands lightly on either side of your head keeping your elbows in. Tip: Don't lock your fingers behind your head.
While pushing the small of your back down in the bench to better isolate your abdominal muscles, begin to roll your shoulders off it.

Continue to push down as hard as you can with your lower back as you contract your abdominals and exhale. Your shoulders should come up off the bench only about four inches, and your lower back should remain on the bench. At the top of the movement, contract your abdominals hard and keep the contraction for a second. Tip: Focus on slow, controlled movement - don't cheat yourself by using momentum.
After the one second contraction, begin to come down slowly again to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Decline Reverse Crunch
steps: Lie on your back on a decline bench and hold on to the top of the bench with both hands. Don't let your body slip down from this position.

Hold your legs parallel to the floor using your abs to hold them there while keeping your knees and feet together. Tip: Your legs should be fully extended with a slight bend on the knee. This will be your starting position.
While exhaling, move your legs towards the torso as you roll your pelvis backwards and you raise your hips off the bench. At the end of this movement your knees will be touching your chest.
Hold the contraction for a second and move your legs back to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
cues: Roll the pelvis upward; do not merely swing the legs with momentum.
Maintain control on the descent and prevent excessive spinal hyperextension.

name: Inverted Row
steps: Position a bar in a rack to about waist height. You can also use a smith machine.

Take a wider than shoulder width grip on the bar and position yourself hanging underneath the bar. Your body should be straight with your heels on the ground with your arms fully extended. This will be your starting position.
Begin by flexing the elbow, pulling your chest towards the bar. Retract your shoulder blades as you perform the movement.
Pause at the top of the motion, and return yourself to the start position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Janda Sit-Up
steps: Position your body on the floor in the basic sit-up position; knees to a ninety degree angle with feet flat on the floor and arms either crossed over your chest or to the sides. This will be your starting position.

As you strongly tighten your glutes and hamstrings, fill your lungs with air and in a slow (three to six second count) ascent, slowly exhale. Tip: It is important to tighten the glutes and hamstrings as this will cause the hip flexors to be inactivated in a process called reciprocal inhibition, which basically means that opposite muscles to the contracted ones will relax.
As you inhale, slowly go back in a controlled manner to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Oblique Crunches
steps: Lie flat on the floor with your lower back pressed to the ground. For this exercise, you will need to put one hand beside your head and the other to the side against the floor.
Make sure your feet are elevated and resting on a flat surface.
Now lift the shoulder in which your hand is touching your head.

Simply elevate your shoulder and body upward until you touch your knee. For example, if you have your right hand besides your head, then you want to elevate your body upwards until your right elbow touches your left knee. The same variation can be applied doing the inverse and using your left elbow to touch your right knee.
After your knee touches your elbow, lower your body until you have reached the starting position.
Remember to breathe in during the eccentric (lowering) part of the exercise and to breathe out during the concentric (upward) part of the exercise.
Continue alternating in this manner until all of the recommended repetitions for each side have been completed.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Rocket Jump
steps: Begin in a relaxed stance with your feet shoulder width apart and hold your arms close to the body.
To initiate the move, squat down halfway and explode back up as high as possible.
Fully extend your entire body, reaching overhead as far as possible. As you land, absorb your impact through the legs.
cues: Explode upward through full triple extension of ankles, knees, and hips.
Land softly with knee and hip flexion to absorb ground reaction forces.

name: Bicycle Crunches
steps: Lie on your back.
Bring your left elbow to your right knee while extending the opposite leg.
Pedal legs smoothly in a continuous cycling motion.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Squat Jumps
steps: Squat down and explode vertically into a maximal jump.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Bosu Squat
steps: Carefully stand with both feet on the convex side (dome up).
Establish your balance and center your core.
Gently bend your knees as if you were going to sit down and come up again.
Keep your back flat and neutral.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Bosu Burpee & Press
steps: Hold the Bosu (convex side down).
Jump back into plank, do a push-up, jump back and lift the Bosu explosive above your head (Overhead Press).
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Bosu Plank (Tilt)
steps: Support your forearms on the convex side.
Hold a solid, rigid plank.
Gently tilt the Bosu forward, back, left and right without breaking your board.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Bosu Side Lunge
steps: Stand beside the BOSU ball.
Step onto the BOSU dome and sink into a single-leg lunge while your trail leg stays long.
Drive yourself forcefully back to the starting position.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Bosu Russian Twist
steps: Sit on the rounded side.
Lean back slightly and lift your feet off the floor.
Rotate your upper body and hands from left to right.
Keep balance.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Bosu Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back on the floor.
Place both feet onto the dome surface of the BOSU ball.
Drive your hips upward and contract your glutes.
Lower smoothly back to the starting position.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Bosu Superman
steps: Lie with your stomach over the rounded side.
Extend your arms and legs fully.
Lift them at the same time so that your body forms an arch.
Hold the peak contraction briefly before lowering.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Bosu Tricep Dips
steps: Sit in front of the Bosu (on the floor) with your back to it.
Place your hands firmly on the dome surface.
Push yourself up and lower yourself through your arms.
Keep your elbows narrow.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Bosu Bird Dog
steps: Kneel with both knees on the convex side.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Extend your right arm forward and left leg backward in a bird dog.
Keep balance and switch sides.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Weighted Crunch / Sit-up
steps: Lie on the Bosu so that your lower back is supported.
Hold a weight (or hands) near your chest/head.
Crunch up and feel the stretch as you sink back down.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Platform Tilt Push Up
steps: Place the BOSU ball dome-down with the flat platform facing upward.
Grip the outer edges securely.
Perform a push-up while keeping the BOSU platform balanced and stable.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Bosu Mountain Climbers
steps: Place the Bosu with the convex side down.
Support your hands on the flat surface (plank position).
Drive your knees alternately in a mountain climber while keeping the BOSU platform stable.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Bosu V-Sit / V-Ups
steps: Sit with your buttocks just in front of the center of the convex side.
Lift your legs and upper body simultaneously into a sharp V-up.
Maintain balance while bracing your abdominals with maximum tension.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Bosu Side Plank
steps: Place your forearm on the convex side.
Extend your legs and elevate your hips into a reverse plank.
Your body forms a straight line.
Hold this position and switch sides.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Bosu Toe Taps
steps: Tap the top of the BOSU dome rapidly with alternating toe touches.
Perform light, bouncy skips maintaining a fast cadence.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Bosu Squat Jump
steps: Stand balancing on the dome of the BOSU ball.
Lower into a squat and jump up explosively (apart from the Bosu).
Try to land stably and softly on the convex side again.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back, one foot on the rounded side, the other leg extended in the air.
Push your hips up from the leg on the Bosu.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Single Leg Balance Hold
steps: Stand on one leg on the rounded side.
Keep your knee slightly bent.
Try to maintain the hold for as long as possible (e.g.
30 sec) to remain standing without touching the ground with your other foot.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Single Leg Deadlift
steps: Balance on one leg on the dome surface of the BOSU ball.
Hinge forward at the hips while extending your free leg straight back.
Maintain a flat back and optionally tap the floor with the weight.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Bosu Ball Cable Crunch With Side Bends
aliases: Bosu Ball Cable Crunch With Side Bends
steps: Position a Bosu ball before low cable handles, lying with lower back arched over the dome.
Grasp handles, extend arms forward, and crunch your torso upward against cable tension.
Lower under control, then perform alternating side bends to finish each round.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Cable Crossover
steps: Set pulleys high, grasp single handles, and take a staggered step forward.
With a slight bend in elbows, pull arms forward and downward in an arc until hands meet across the chest.
Pause to squeeze pecs, then slowly open arms back under control.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Cable Kneeling Crunch
steps: Kneel below a high pulley fitted with a rope attachment. Hold rope ends beside your ears.
Hips remain stationary while you curl your torso downward, driving elbows toward thighs via abdominal contraction.
Slowly return to the top stretched position.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Curl with the spine rather than hinging at the hips.

name: Cable Iron Cross
steps: Set pulleys high, hold handles with arms extended laterally forming a T-shape.
Keeping elbows extended with a slight soft bend, pull arms straight down to your sides.
Pause at peak contraction and return under control to the start.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Cable Preacher Curl
steps: Place a preacher bench in front of a low pulley with a straight or EZ bar attachment.
Rest upper arms firmly on the pad with arms fully extended.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders, squeezing biceps hard at the top.
Lower weight slowly until arms are extended.
cues: Maintain armpits locked over the top edge of the pad.
Avoid lifting your elbows off the bench during the curl.

name: Cable Chest Press
steps: Adjust handles to chest height, seated or standing in a staggered stance.
Press both handles straight forward by extending elbows and adducting chest.
Hold peak extension momentarily, then return hands back with control under continuous tension.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Cable Hammer Curls (Rope Attachment)
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and grasp the rope with a neutral, palms-in grip.
Keep elbows pinned to your sides and curl the rope upward toward your shoulders.
Squeeze biceps and brachialis firmly at the top, then slowly lower to arm extension.
cues: Keep elbows fixed at your sides throughout the repetition.
Spread the rope slightly outward at the top contraction.

name: Cable Hip Adduction
steps: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and secure it to the ankle closest to the weight stack.
Stand tall and step out to create tension.
Pull the resisted leg across the front of your standing leg using the inner thigh.
Slowly control the leg back toward the pulley and repeat.
cues: Keep your pelvis level and avoid swinging your upper torso.
Initiate movement smoothly from the inner thigh adductor muscles.

name: Cable Incline Pushdown (Straight-Arm)
steps: Lie back on an incline bench facing away from a high pulley bar.
Grip the bar overhead with arms straight and elbows slightly soft.
Pull the bar in a wide arc down toward your thighs using lat contraction.
Pause to squeeze lats, then allow the bar to travel smoothly back overhead.
cues: Keep arms straight to isolate lats and prevent triceps takeover.
Brace core to keep back stable against the incline pad.

name: Cable Incline Triceps Extension
steps: Lie on an incline bench facing away from a high pulley machine with a straight bar attached.
Grasp the bar with a narrow overhand grip, elbows tucked close to your torso.
Keeping upper arms stationary, extend through the elbows to push the bar forward and down.
Squeeze the triceps firmly at lockout and slowly return to the starting stretch.
cues: Keep your upper arms stationary throughout the entire movement.
Avoid flaring your elbows wide outward.

name: Cable Internal Rotation
steps: Set a cable pulley at elbow height and stand or sit sideways to the machine.
Grasp the single handle with the inside arm, keeping your elbow bent at 90 degrees against your ribs.
Rotate your forearm inward across your abdomen against cable resistance.
Slowly control the handle back to the starting point and repeat.
cues: Keep your elbow pinned tightly against your torso.
Perform rotation strictly from the shoulder rotator cuff without twisting the spine.

name: Cable Judo Flip
steps: Attach a rope to the lowest pulley setting and stand sideways with a wide athletic base.
Hold the rope in both hands and pivot your hips away from the machine, pulling the rope over your shoulder like a judo throw.
Crunch forward diagonally and shift your weight into the front foot.
Reset under control and repeat for repetitions before switching sides.
cues: Pivot off the rear foot to generate torque from the hips.
Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.

name: Cable Lying Triceps Extension
steps: Lie flat on a bench facing a low cable pulley fitted with a straight bar.
Hold the bar overhead with an overhand grip, upper arms perpendicular to the floor.
Lower the bar toward your forehead by bending at the elbows while keeping upper arms still.
Contract triceps to extend the bar back up to vertical arm lockout.
cues: Keep elbows pointing straight up toward the ceiling without swaying.
Maintain controlled eccentric lowering toward the forehead.

name: Cable One Arm Tricep Extension
steps: Grasp a single handle attached to a high pulley using an underhand or neutral grip.
Pin your working elbow against your side with forearm bent above 90 degrees.
Extend the elbow downward until the arm is completely straight.
Squeeze the triceps for a second and control the return back up.
cues: Isolate movement purely to the elbow joint; do not swing the upper arm.
Keep shoulders level and posture upright.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
steps: Set pulleys above head height and grasp the opposite cables without handles (cross cables in front).
Stand tall, arms extended forward at chest height.
Pull arms horizontally out and back in a wide arc until hands are past your shoulders.
Pause to squeeze rear deltoids, then slowly return to the cross position.
cues: Maintain a slight soft bend in your elbows throughout the arc.
Focus on pulling through the elbows to isolate rear deltoids.

name: SkiErg Double Pole
steps: Stand hip-width apart.
Grip the high handles firmly.
Pull down with your arms straight by tightening your abdominal muscles and bending your knees (crunch movement).
Smoothly swing your arms back up to the top starting position.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Sled Push (Slee Duwen)
steps: Set the resistance high.
Grip either the low or high handles based on preferred leverage.
Lean far forward and push the tire backwards with strong steps.
Keep your back flat and neutral.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Lateral Shuffle (Zijwaarts)
steps: Stand sideways on the band.
Stay low in your hips (squat position) and shuffle sideways without crossing your feet.
Switch sides after a brief interval.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Power Sprints (100m)
steps: Set the resistance high.
Execute short, explosive rowing strokes pulling with maximum force.
Focus on an extremely hard push-off with the legs.
Try to row 100 meters as fast as possible.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Airbike Legs Only
steps: Let go of the handles (or place your hands on your lap/handlebar in the middle).
Only cycle with your legs.
This isolates the quadriceps and takes help away from the upper body.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Curved Treadmill Sprint
steps: Set the resistance low.
Start running; because the band is curved, you determine the pace yourself.
Run toward the front curve of the curved treadmill belt to accelerate.
Sprint flat out for 15-30 seconds.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Parachute Run
steps: Put on the waist belt/harness (if equipped) or select the parachute position.
Sprint at full speed driving against the progressive air resistance.
The faster you run, the harder it gets.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: SkiErg Alternating Arms
steps: Pull the SkiErg handles down alternately mimicking a classic cross-country ski glide.
Keep your core tight and create a rhythmic movement with one arm raising while the other pulls down.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Backward Walk (Achteruit Lopen)
steps: Turn around and walk backwards on the belt.
If necessary, hold the railing for balance.
Set the resistance to a medium level.
Good for knee stability and quadriceps.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Rowing (Basis Techniek)
steps: Order is Legs-Back-Arms.
Push out from your legs, lean back slightly and pull the handle toward your chest.
Recovery phase: Extend arms forward, hinge torso forward at hips, then bend knees to slide back.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Airbike Sprint
steps: Use both your arms and your legs.
Push and pull forcefully on the handlebars while pedaling aggressively.
Try for a certain number of calories or seconds (e.g.
20 sec) maximum to go.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

video.channel: CrossFit Monarch X Functional strength training

name: Airbike Upper Body Only
steps: Place your feet on the stationary foot pegs rather than the pedals.
Use only your arms to keep the fan moving.
Focus on pushing and pulling from your chest and back.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Slalom Run
steps: Place pawns in a straight line behind each other (1m apart).
Weave rapidly between the cones in a zigzag pattern without contacting them.
Keep your center of gravity low in an athletic stance.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: W-Drill
steps: Place pawns in a 'W'.
Sprint forward to the first apex, then backpedal diagonally to the next depth point.
Repeat this pattern throughout the entire W.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: X-Drill
steps: Start at the bottom-left marker.
Sprint diagonally to the top right.
Shuffle sideways to the top left.
Sprint diagonally to the bottom right.
Lateral shuffle back to the starting marker.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Pro Agility Shuttle (5-10-5)
steps: Start stationed in the center.
Sprint 5m to the right, tap the line.
Sprint 10 meters to the left and touch the boundary line.
Sprint 5m back through the middle.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: 4 Corner Drill
steps: Start stationed in the center.
Sprint to a corner cone, round the marker, and sprint back to the central hub.
Turn around the center pawn and go to the next corner.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Figure 8
steps: Place two pawns 5m apart.
Run around the cones in a figure of 8.
Stay low in the corners and accelerate on the straights.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Nebraska Agility Drill
steps: Sprint forward, plant and pivot 180 degrees, sprint back, and accelerate into a long sprint.
Focus on braking and turning quickly (turn-and-go).
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Y-Drill
steps: Sprint 5-10 meters forward to the fork marker.
React to an auditory or visual cue and sprint diagonally toward the indicated cone.
(Without signal: choose a side yourself).
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Reactive 4 Cone Drill
steps: Stand in the center of a cone square with 4 colored/numbered markers.
Your partner calls out a color or number; sprint and tap the designated cone before returning to center.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Circle Drill
steps: Sprint at top speed navigating around the circular cone perimeter.
Try to stay as close to the cones as possible and lean in.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Arrow Drill
steps: Run to the point of the arrow, shuffle diagonally back to one side, run to the point again and shuffle to the other side.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Suicide Runs
steps: Place 4 pawns in a row (0m, 5m, 10m, 15m).
Sprint to the first cone, touch the line, and sprint back to the baseline.
Sprint to the second cone, touch the line, and sprint back.
Continue alternating in this rhythm.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: T-Drill
steps: Sprint 10m forward, shuffle 5m to the left, shuffle 10m to the right (past the center), shuffle 5m back to the center and run backwards back to the start.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Box Drill (Square)
steps: Form a box or cone square grid.
Sprint forward to cone 2, lateral shuffle to cone 3, backpedal to cone 4, and shuffle back to cone 1.
Always keep looking in the same direction.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Zig-Zag Sprint
steps: Place pawns in a zigzag pattern (approx.
5m distance).
Sprint from pawn to pawn.
Decelerate sharply at the cone, drop your hips, and accelerate toward the next marker.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: L-Drill (3 Cone Drill)
steps: Sprint 5m forward, touch line, sprint back.
Sprint forward again, go around the second cone, turn around the third cone (walk the bend) and sprint back to the start.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: M-Drill
steps: Sprint forward, diagonally backpedal, sprint to the next marker, and backpedal to finish.
Forms the letter M.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Lateral Cone Hops
steps: Stand next to a pawn.
Jump sideways over the pawn with two feet at the same time and immediately back again.
Minimize ground contact time with quick, elastic bounces.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Hourglass Drill
steps: Start at a corner, sprint diagonally to the center hub, shuffle laterally, and sprint diagonally to the far corner.
Trace the diagonal boundary lines of an hourglass cone drill.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Slider Arm Flys
steps: Kneel on the floor with your palms placed on sliding discs.
Simultaneously slide both hands wide out (like a chest fly) and pull them back to the center using your pecs.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Slider Alligator Walk
steps: Place your toes on the sliding discs in a high plank position.
Walk forward on your hands only, dragging your feet behind you on the ground.
Maintain a completely rigid and straight core.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Slider Mountain Climbers
steps: High plank, feet on the sliders.
Pull your knees alternately toward your chest in a smooth, gliding motion.
Keep your hips low.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Slider Archer Push Ups
steps: Hands on the sliders.
As you lower into a push-up, slide one arm out wide to the side (extended).
The other arm partially bends.
Pull the weight back in as you return to standing.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Slider Lateral Lunge
steps: Stand up straight with one foot on a slider.
Slide that foot out wide to the side as your supporting leg bends.
Keep the sliding leg straight and pull it back.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Slider Curtsy Lunge
steps: Stand up straight with one foot on a slider.
Slide that foot diagonally behind your supporting leg (make a bow).
Return to the starting position in a controlled manner.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Dead Ball Chest Pass (Wall/Floor)
steps: Chest pass the heavy medicine ball explosively forward against a wall, to a partner, or into the ground.
Step in firmly with your front foot.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Dead Ball Clean
steps: Ball on the ground between the feet.
Lift it explosively (use your hips) and catch it at chest height.
Fully extend your hips.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Rainbow Slams
steps: Lift the ball, rotate your torso, and slam the ball into the floor beside your left foot.
Lift it over your head in a large arc (rainbow) and slam next to your right foot.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Dead Ball Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent.
Place the heavy ball on your hips.
Push hips up and squeeze buttocks.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Plank Pull Through
steps: Start in a high plank with the medicine ball resting beside your torso.
Reach underneath your torso with your far hand to drag the medicine ball across to the opposite side.
Keep hips still.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Dead Ball Jump Slams
steps: Raise the ball high, jump into the air, and slam the ball down with full force as you land.
Use your whole body.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Dead Ball Sit Ups
steps: Hold the ball against your chest (or with straight arms for heavier weights) and do a sit-up.
Keep your feet on the ground.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Dead Ball Slams
steps: Lift the ball high overhead and slam it with maximum force into the ground directly in front of your feet.
Bend your knees during the throw.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Dead Ball Walking Lunges
steps: Hold the ball against your chest or on one shoulder.
Step into a lunge, step forward together, and lunge with the opposite leg.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Dead Ball Thruster
steps: Hold the ball in front of your chest.
Lower into a squat.
Stand up and press the ball overhead in one fluid, continuous motion.
Catch the rebounding ball at chest height.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Dead Ball Step Up
steps: Hold the ball on one shoulder or in front of the chest.
Step onto a plyo box or bench.
Press yourself upward to the starting position.
Switch legs.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Dead Ball Good Morning
steps: Hold the medicine ball tightly clamped against your chest.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings, then squeeze glutes to return.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Bear Hug Carry
steps: Lift the medicine ball and hug it tightly against your torso.
Walk forward for the designated distance.
Stay upright, do not let your back collapse.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Dead Ball Floor Press
steps: Lie on your back.
Hold the ball on your chest with both hands.
Push the ball straight up (explosive) and lower in a controlled manner.
cues: Maintain an active, braced core and steady breathing cadence.
Focus on quality of movement and full range of motion.

name: Weighted Step Ups
steps: Perform elevated step-ups holding weights at your sides.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Overhead Press
steps: Establish a strong, grounded athletic stance.
Push the weights straight up from the shoulders.
Tighten your buttocks and stomach to avoid sagging in your back.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
steps: Lie on the ground.
Hold the dumbbells directly above your chest.
Lower until your triceps lightly touch the floor, then press back up.
Good alternative to bench press.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Single Arm Dumbbell Snatch
steps: Dumbbell on the ground.
Lower into squat, grab with one hand.
In one explosive movement, pull the dumbbell up along your body above your head.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
steps: Stand tall with upright posture.
Lift the weights sideways to shoulder height.
Keep a slight bend in the elbows.
Lower smoothly back to the starting position.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
steps: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest (hands under the top disk).
Place your feet slightly wider than your hips and lower into a deep squat.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly
steps: Bend forward at the hips (straight back).
Keep the weights positioned under your chest.
Raise your arms laterally like wings and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Hammer Curls
steps: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other (neutral grip).
Curl up without moving the elbows.
Good for biceps and forearms.
cues: Maintain an active, braced core and steady breathing cadence.
Focus on quality of movement and full range of motion.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: Hold one heavy weight (or two lighter weights) overhead with locked-out arms.
Bend your elbows and lower the weight behind your head.
Extend fully through your joints.
cues: Maintain an active, braced core and steady breathing cadence.
Focus on quality of movement and full range of motion.

name: Ball Leg Curl
steps: Begin on the floor laying on your back with your feet on top of the ball.
Position the ball so that when your legs are extended your ankles are on top of the ball. This will be your starting position.
Raise your hips off of the ground, keeping your weight on the shoulder blades and your feet.
Flex the knees, pulling the ball as close to you as you can, contracting the hamstrings.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
cues: Keep hips elevated high throughout the curling motion.
Do not allow lower back to hyperextend; keep glutes and core engaged.

video.channel: Powered By Movement Physical Therapy & Performance

name: Preacher Curl
steps: To perform this movement you will need a preacher bench and an E-Z bar. Grab the E-Z curl bar at the close inner handle. The palm of your hands should be facing forward and slightly tilted inwards.
With the upper arms positioned against the preacher bench pad and the chest against it, hold the E-Z Curl Bar at shoulder length. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, slowly lower the bar until your upper arm is extended and the biceps is fully stretched.
As you exhale, use the biceps to curl the weight up until your biceps is fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder height. Squeeze the biceps hard and hold this position for a second.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
cues: Maintain full upper arm contact with the pad throughout the rep.
Avoid bouncing or violently locking out elbows at the bottom of the stretch.

name: Reverse EZ-Bar Preacher Curls
steps: Grab an EZ-bar using a shoulder-width and palms-down (pronated) overhand grip.
Now place the upper part of both arms on top of the preacher bench and have your arms extended. This will be your starting position.
As you exhale, use the forearms and biceps to curl the weight up until the bar is at shoulder height. Squeeze hard for a second at the top.
As you breathe in, slowly lower the barbell until your upper arms are extended and the muscles are fully stretched.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
cues: Keep upper arms flat against the preacher pad throughout the movement.
Maintain a strict pronated grip without twisting the wrists.

name: Close-Grip EZ-Bar Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench with an EZ bar loaded to an appropriate weight.
Using a narrow grip lift the bar and hold it straight over your torso with your elbows in. The arms should be perpendicular to the floor. This will be your starting position.
Now lower the bar down to your lower chest as you breathe in. Keep the elbows in as you perform this movement.
Using the triceps to push the bar back up, press it back to the starting position by extending the elbows as you exhale.
Repeat.
cues: Keep elbows tucked tightly to your sides throughout the movement.
Maintain wrists in a neutral, supported alignment on the EZ curls.

name: Decline EZ Bar Triceps Extension
steps: Secure your legs at the end of the decline bench and slowly lay down on the bench.

Using a close grip (a grip that is slightly less than shoulder width), lift the EZ bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked and elbows in. The arms should be perpendicular to the floor. This will be your starting position. Tip: In order to protect your rotator cuff, it is best if you have a spotter help you lift the barbell off the rack.

As you breathe in and you keep the upper arms stationary, bring the bar down slowly by moving your forearms in a semicircular motion towards you until you feel the bar slightly touch your forehead. Breathe in as you perform this portion of the movement.
Lift the bar back to the starting position by contracting the triceps and exhaling.
Repeat until the recommended amount of repetitions is performed.
cues: Keep your upper arms stationary perpendicular to the torso.
Control the lowering phase and avoid flaring elbows wide.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
steps: Stand up straight while holding an EZ curl bar at the wide outer handle. The palms of your hands should be facing forward and slightly tilted inward due to the shape of the bar. Keep your elbows close to your torso. This will be your starting position.
Now, while keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights forward while contracting the biceps. Focus on only moving your forearms.
Continue to raise the weight until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level. Hold the top contracted position for a moment and squeeze the biceps.
Then inhale and slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
cues: Maintain an active, braced core and steady breathing cadence.
Focus on quality of movement and full range of motion.

name: Butt Kicks
steps: Run in place and kick your butt with your heels on each jump.
Keep your knees pointing straight down.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Criss Cross / Crossover
steps: Cross your arms in front of your body on the downward swing and jump through the rope loop.
Separate your arms again for the next jump.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Side Swings
steps: Keep your feet anchored or perform light rhythmic hops.
Swing the rope along the side of your body (left and right) without jumping over it.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Running in Place
steps: Run in place.
The jump rope clears under one foot at a time in a boxer step.
Work on increasing your pedal stroke cadence.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Double Side Swing
steps: Make two side swings (left-right) and then jump through the rope.
Good for rhythm control.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Mummy Kicks
steps: Kick your legs straight forward (small kicks) with each jump.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: High Knees
steps: Run in place and pull your knees up to hip height with each jump over the rope.
Keep a fast pace.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Single Leg Jumps
steps: Jump on one leg continuously.
Switch sides after the designated number of reps (e.g.
10 left, 10 right).
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Bell Jumps
steps: Jump forward and back with both feet at the same time (like a bell clapper).
Stay in a rhythm.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Heel Taps
steps: Tap the ground in front of you alternately with your heel as you jump.
A dynamic variation of the classic boxing shuffle step.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Backward Jumping
steps: Turn the rope the other way (backwards).
Jump when the rope passes your heels.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Scissors
steps: Jump and land with one foot in front and one foot behind (lunge-like stance).
Switch your feet mid-air on every jump.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Alternate Foot Step
steps: The classic 'skipping'.
Hop on one foot, then the other.
It's like running, but with a little hop in between.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Squat Jumps
steps: Perform a few speed rope jumps, then drop into a low squat hold while continuing to turn the rope.
Come up explosively.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: 180 Turn
steps: Jump and rotate your entire body 180 degrees in the air.
Land and jump further (backward or forward).
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Jumping Jacks
steps: Jump with your feet wide and narrow as you continue to twist the rope.
Coordination Challenge!
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Kettlebell Clean
steps: Clean the kettlebell in one smooth trajectory from the floor or swing into the rack position.
Rotate your wrist smoothly so the kettlebell lands gently without slamming your forearm.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
steps: Hold the kettlebell by the 'horns' (side handle) in front of the chest.
Descend into a full, deep squat.
Elbows track downward inside your knees.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Farmers Carry
steps: Hold a heavy kettlebell in each hand by the handles.
Walk upright using quick, short, controlled strides.
Squeeze the handles hard and keep your shoulders low and back.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Hand-to-Hand Swing
steps: Perform a single-arm kettlebell swing.
Switch the kettlebell to the opposite hand at the weightless apex float of the swing.
Keep your shoulders square and brace your core during the hand switch.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Seesaw Kettlebell Press
steps: Hold two kettlebells secured in the front rack position against your chest.
While one arm pushes up, the other arm comes down in a controlled manner.
Both arms are in constant motion like a see-saw.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Kettlebell Waiter Walk
steps: Hold the kettlebell by the ball itself (not the handle) on top of your palm near your shoulder, or with an extended arm above your head.
Walk smoothly for the designated distance.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Kettlebell Plank (on handles)
steps: Place two kettlebells shoulder-width apart.
Assume a plank position grasping the handles firmly.
The focus is on stabilizing the bells and your core.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Staggered Stance RDL
steps: Stand with one foot stepped slightly behind on your toe for balance in a kickstand stance.
Perform a Romanian deadlift with 90% of your weight balanced on your lead leg.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Kettlebell Figure 8
steps: Stand in a wide stance with knees soft and torso hinged.
Pass the kettlebell between the legs from one hand to the other in a figure-8 shape.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Sumo Squat
steps: Position feet wide with toes angled outward in a sumo stance.
Pockets with straight back.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Bottom-Up Kettlebell Squat
steps: Hold the kettlebell upside down (bottom to ceiling) at your shoulder.
Balance the ball as you perform a full squat.
This requires extreme grip strength and stability.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Kettlebell Cossack Squat
steps: Hold the KB in goblet position.
Take an exaggeratedly wide lateral step.
Lower deeply to one side while turning the toe of your extended leg toward the ceiling.
Keep your heel on the ground.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

video.channel: CrossFit Monarch X Functional strength training

name: Sumo Deadlift High Pull
steps: Take a wide athletic stance.
Explosively clean the kettlebell off the floor by snapping your hips and legs.
Pull the kettlebell vertically to collarbone height with elbows flaring high in a high pull.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Kettlebell Halo
steps: Hold the kettlebell upside down by the horns.
Wind the ball tightly around your head (like a halo).
Keep your ribcage low and core tense.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Kettlebell Bent Press
steps: A classic strongman movement building brutal full-body power.
Bring the kettlebell up to the side of your shoulder into the rack position.
Lean sideways and forward ("away from the weight") as you straighten your arm.
Then stand up straight.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Ball Lunges
steps: Hold the ball against your chest or above your head.
Perform walking lunges with upright posture.
Maintain an upright torso.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Ball Back Extension
steps: Lie on your stomach over the ball (hips on the ball).
Clamp the feet or keep them on the ground.
Raise your upper body (straighten your back).
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Ball Sit Ups
steps: Hold the ball against your chest or above your head.
Sit all the way up into an upright seated position.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Ball Squat Press
steps: Lower into a squat with the ball at chest height.
Come up and immediately push the ball upwards (thruster movement).
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Overhead Lunge Throws
steps: Make a lunge and simultaneously throw the ball (that you held above your head) to a partner or wall.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Stir The Pot
steps: Hold a plank resting your forearms on the medicine ball.
Rotate your elbows in circles without letting your torso move.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Lateral Slam
steps: Stand tall with the medicine ball pressed overhead.
Turn your body and forcefully throw the ball onto the ground on the outside of your foot.
Repeat on the other side.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

video.channel: Dr. Frank Tardi, PT, DPT, CSCS

name: Medicine Ball Toe Taps
steps: Place the medicine ball on the floor in front of you.
Tap the top of the ball alternately with the ball of your foot in a hopping motion.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Medicine Ball Mountain Climbers
steps: Place both hands on the ball in a plank position.
Quickly pull your knees alternately toward your chest while keeping the ball steady.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Single Leg RDL
steps: Balance on one leg holding the medicine ball out in front of your chest.
Bend forward at your hips while stretching your free leg back.
Hold the ball directly under your shoulders.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Medicine Ball Floor Press
steps: Lie on your back with the ball on your chest.
Push the ball straight up until your arms are fully extended and lower in a controlled manner.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Medicine Ball Plank
steps: Place both hands onto the medicine ball and assume a plank position.
Tighten your abdominal muscles and buttocks to keep your body in a straight line.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Skin the Cat
steps: Pull your knees to your chest and tilt back.
Pass your feet under and through the bar into a skin-the-cat, lowering them toward the floor behind you.
Turn back in a controlled manner.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Hanging Bicycle Crunches
steps: Hang from the bar.
Make a cycling motion with your legs.
Alternately pull your knee high while extending the other leg.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Typewriter Pull Ups
steps: Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Stay at the top and slide your body horizontally from your left hand to your right hand and back again.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Dead Hang
steps: Grip the pull-up bar and hang completely relaxed in a full dead hang.
Keep your feet off the floor and focus on hanging grip strength.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Backward Traverse
steps: Move backwards over the monkey bars.
Blindly grab the bar behind you while keeping your core stable.
A demanding test of agility, rhythm, and coordination.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Hanging Windshield Wipers
steps: Hang from the bar and pull your legs up until your feet point toward the ceiling.
Rotate your legs and hips in a controlled manner from left to right like a windshield wiper.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Hanging Knee Raises (Knee Ups)
steps: Hang from the bar with your arms extended.
Pull your knees up towards your chest as high as possible.
Tighten your abdominal muscles and gently lower your legs without swinging.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Straight Bar Dips (Tricep Dips)
steps: Support your body above the bar with locked arms in a front support hold.
Lower your arms until your chest almost touches the bar.
Press yourself powerfully back up to the top.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: L-Sit Hang
steps: Hang from the bar.
Raise your straight legs up until parallel to the floor in an L-sit hold.
Hold this position for as long as possible and breathe calmly.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
