Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Around the World (Abs)
steps: Hang straight.
Rotate your legs in a large circular motion: lift them to the left, rotate to the center (top) and lower them to the right.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Tuck Front Lever
steps: Hang from the bar.
Tilt your entire body back until your back is horizontal.
Keep your knees tucked tightly to your chest and hold the position.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Oblique Knee Raises
steps: Hang from the bar.
Drive your knees up diagonally toward your outside shoulder targeting obliques.
Switch sides and repeat.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Commando Pull Ups
steps: Stand sideways under the bar.
Grip the bar with one hand in front of the other in a baseball grip.
Pull yourself up and move your head alternately left and right along the bar.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Pull Ups
steps: Grip the bar with palms facing away in a wide overhand grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower yourself in a controlled manner until your arms are straight again.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Monkey Bar Traverse
steps: Traverse the monkey bars from one end to the other by grasping each rung hand-over-hand.
Maintain fluid momentum and swing smoothly through each repetition.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Side Traverse
steps: Hang sideways from one bar.
Move your hands sideways to move the length of the bar (or from bar to bar) without touching the ground.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Scapular Pull Ups
steps: Hang with arms fully extended.
Only pull your shoulder blades together and down (without bending your elbows).
Hold the peak contraction briefly before lowering.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Lying Face Down Plate Neck Resistance
aliases: Lying Face Down Plate Neck Resistance
steps: Lie face down with your whole body straight on a flat bench while holding a weight plate behind your head. Tip: Position yourself so your upper chest, neck, and face are off the bench.
While keeping the plate secure on the back of your head, slowly lower your head as you breathe in.
Raise your head back up to the starting position in a semi-circular motion as you breathe out. Hold the contraction for a second.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
cues: Use a light weight plate and perform strict, smooth repetitions.
Avoid aggressive hyperextension of the cervical spine at the top of the lift.

name: Lying Face Up Plate Neck Resistance
aliases: Lying Face Up Plate Neck Resistance
steps: Lie face up with your whole body straight on a flat bench while holding a weight plate on top of your forehead. Tip: Position yourself so traps, neck, and head are off the bench.
While keeping the plate secure on your forehead slowly lower your head back in a semi-circular motion as you breathe in.
Raise your head back up to the starting position in a semi-circular motion as you breathe out. Hold the contraction for a second.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
cues: Keep hands firmly on the plate to ensure it stays securely centered on the forehead.
Move through a controlled, pain-free range of motion without jerking.

name: Parallette Dips
steps: Support your body above the parallettes with arms locked out.
Bend your elbows to 90 degrees (or slightly below if shoulder mobility permits) and press up to lockout.
Legs can be stretched out in front of you or with feet on the ground for support.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Pass Through / Shoot Through
steps: Start in a standard push-up position.
Swing your legs forward under your body (L-sit position) without touching the ground, and swing back again.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Pike Push Up
steps: Keep feet on the floor and hands gripping the parallette bars.
Drive your hips high into the air to form an inverted V-shape.
Lower your head towards the ground between your hands.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Bodyweight Tricep Extension
steps: Hands on the bars, body in plank position.
Bend your elbows to lower your head below the bars.
Extend your arms forcefully utilizing pure triceps power.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: V-Sit
steps: An advanced version of the L-sit where you lift your legs high into a sharp V-sit position.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Deep Push Up
steps: Elevate your feet on a bench with hands gripping the parallettes.
Sink your shoulders as deeply as possible for maximum stretch of the pectoral muscle.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Parallette Push Up
steps: Grab the parallettes.
Descend deep between the parallettes and press yourself powerfully back up.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: L-Sit
steps: Press yourself upward between the dip bars to full arm lockout.
Lift your legs straight and horizontally so that your body forms an 'L'.
Keep your shoulders depressed down away from your ears.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Handstand Push Up (HSPU)
steps: Press into a handstand on the parallettes, either freestanding or supported against a wall.
Lower your arms in a controlled manner until your head almost touches the ground and push out again.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Parallette Mountain Climbers
steps: Hands on the bars (plank).
Quickly pull your knees towards your chest.
The elevation allows you to retract your knees extra far.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Burpee Over Parallette
steps: Do a burpee next to the parallette.
Then jump sideways over the parallettes and immediately make another one.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Decline Push Up
steps: Elevate your feet onto the parallettes with hands flat on the floor.
Perform standard push-ups.
This places more emphasis on the top of the chest and shoulders.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Knee Tucks
steps: Support your weight on fully extended arms.
Pull your knees up to your chest and lower them again (without touching the ground).
A preparation for the L-sit.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Straddle L-Sit
steps: Like the L-sit, but with your legs spread wide (outside your arms).
Requires a lot of strength and flexibility in the hips.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Handstand Hold
steps: Hold a handstand on the parallettes.
The neutral grip (palms together) often makes it easier for the wrists than on the floor.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Pseudo Planche Push Up
steps: Push-up where your hands are placed far back (at your hips/waist) and you lean far forward.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Archer Push Up
steps: Set the parallettes wide.
Sink to one side (one arm bends, the other stays straight).
Press up and switch over to the opposite side.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Tuck Planche
steps: Support your weight on fully extended arms.
Lean forward and lift your hips and knees.
Keep your knees tucked into your chest.
Your feet don't touch the ground.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Planche Lean
steps: Start in a push-up position with toes anchored on the floor.
Lean forward over your wrists with locked arms in a planche lean.
Keep your back rounded (protraction) and core tight.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Single Leg L-Sit
steps: Support your bodyweight through your arms.
Extend one leg in an L-sit position, keep the other leg bent or on the ground (lighter version).
Switch legs.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Partner Dragon Flag
steps: Partner A lies supine holding standing Partner B's ankles for stability.
A lifts the entire body (straight) from the shoulders.
B helps or controls the movement.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Partner Leg Press
steps: Partner A lies on their back with legs raised vertically toward the ceiling.
Partner B leans their chest/weight against Partner A's soles to provide resistance.
A bends and extends the legs.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Partner Manual Hamstring Curl
steps: Partner A lies prone on their stomach.
Partner B applies manual resistance against Partner A's heels/ankles.
A tries to bring the heels to the buttocks (curling) while B resists.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Mirror Drill
steps: Pawns at 5m distance.
Partners face each other.
Partner A shuffles laterally while Partner B mirrors the movement to stay directly opposite.
A tries to shake off B.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Partner Resistance Sprint
steps: Partner A sprints forward.
Partner B stands behind providing backward resistance at Partner A's shoulders, hips, or via a harness.
A has to fight for every meter.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Partner Standing Row
steps: Stand facing your partner and grasp right wrists or forearms.
Both partners lean back simultaneously balancing each other's weight.
Pull yourself towards the partner and lower again.
Switch arms.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Partner Towel Bicep Curl
steps: Partner A stands holding the center of a towel to perform bicep curls.
Partner B sits or kneels pulling on the towel ends to create resistance.
A curls against the force of B.
cues: Maintain an active, braced core and steady breathing cadence.
Focus on quality of movement and full range of motion.

name: Partner Wall Sit Pass
steps: Stand side by side in the Wall Sit (back to wall, knees 90 degrees).
Pass a medicine ball or weight to each other with a twist.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Wheelbarrow Walk
steps: Partner A walks forward on hands while Partner B holds their ankles in a wheelbarrow walk.
Keep the core tight, no sagging back.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Fireman's Carry
steps: Lift your partner in the 'fireman's grip' (over the shoulders).
Walk a distance while keeping your core stable.
Switch sides and person.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Partner Help Ups
steps: Partner A lies flat and performs a sit-up.
Partner B stands and assists Partner A through the top of the sit-up.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: 1 Leg Partner Push Overs
steps: Stand facing your partner balancing on a single leg.
Attempt to unbalance your partner by pushing palm-to-palm without touching the floor.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Partner Sit-up High Five
steps: Lie opposite each other and interlock your feet.
Perform a sit-up simultaneously with your partner and give a double high-five at the top.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Partner Sit-up Ball Pass
steps: Lie opposite each other with feet linked together.
Partner A performs a sit-up and passes the medicine ball to Partner B at the top.
B drops with ball and comes up again.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Partner Overhead Throw
steps: Like a throw-in in football.
Ball behind the head, step forward and throw hard at the partner's feet (so it bounces) or at chest height.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Resisted Bear Crawl
steps: Partner A performs a bear crawl.
Partner B holds a resistance band looped around Partner A's hips and provides backward pulling resistance.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Leap Frog
steps: Partner A crouches down low into a compact tuck.
Partner B leapfrogs over Partner A, supporting hands on A's back.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Piggyback Run
steps: Carry your partner on your back in a piggyback hold.
Sprint or power-walk across the designated agility course.
Switch lead legs halfway through the set duration.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Piggyback Squat
steps: Take your partner on your back.
Place your feet slightly wider than hip width.
Perform controlled bodyweight squats carrying your partner as resistance.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Partner Plank Jump Overs
steps: Partner A holds a forearm plank.
Partner B jumps laterally back and forth over Partner A's legs or hips.
Switch sides after 30 seconds.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Box Squat
steps: Stand in front of the box.
Lower into a squat until your buttocks touch the box (sit for a moment without losing tension) and come up explosively.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Lateral Box Jump
steps: Stand sideways alongside the plyo box.
Jump sideways onto the box with both feet at the same time.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Lateral Step Up
steps: Stand sideways next to the box.
Step onto the box with your inside foot and drive up to standing.
Return in a controlled manner.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Seated Box Jump
steps: Start sitting on the box (or a lower box/bench).
Lean forward slightly and jump explosively up (or onto a higher box in front of you).
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Single Leg Box Jump
steps: Stand on one leg facing the plyo box.
Jump up on that leg and land on the box (on one or two feet, depending on level).
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Elevated Pistol Squat
steps: Stand on the edge of the plyo box balancing on one leg.
Squat down on your support leg letting your free leg dangle alongside the box in a skater squat.
Push up again.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Box Plank
steps: Rest your forearms on the plyo box in an incline plank.
Keep your body perfectly straight from head to heels.
For more of a challenge: lift one leg alternately.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Elevated Glute Bridge
steps: Place your feet on the elevated platform with back flat on the floor.
Lift hips.
Allows for an increased, deeper range of motion.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Burpee Box Jump
steps: Perform a burpee on the floor in front of the plyo box.
Immediately from the burpee, jump onto the box with both feet.
Step down safely and repeat.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Standing Anti Rotation Hold
steps: Stand perpendicular to the target or anchor.
the anchor point.
Hold the band straight out in front of you with your arms extended.
Brace against the rotational pull to keep your shoulders and hips square.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Band Lateral Raise
steps: Stand with both feet anchored on the resistance band.
Grasp the band ends and raise your arms laterally up to shoulder height.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbows throughout the movement.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Band Glute Kickback
steps: Attach the band to a low anchor point and wrap the other end around your ankle.
Kick your leg straight back and tighten your buttocks.
cues: Maintain an active, braced core and steady breathing cadence.
Focus on quality of movement and full range of motion.

name: Band Chest Fly
steps: Attach the strap behind you at chest height.
Grasp both ends, step forward, and bring hands together in front of your chest in a fly motion.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Band Good Morning
steps: Stand on the band and put the other end behind your neck.
With your back straight, bend forward from your hips until your torso is almost horizontal and come up again.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Half Kneeling 1 Arm Press
steps: Assume a half-kneeling position on one knee.
More challenging than standing variations because lower-body momentum is eliminated.
Make sure that the gluteal muscle of the back leg is tense and the torso remains straight.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Half Kneeling 1 Arm Row
steps: Assume a half-kneeling position on one knee.
Row the weight upward with one arm keeping your torso stable.
Focus point: Keep the gluteal muscle of the back leg active and ensure that the torso remains vertical (do not rotate).
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Half Kneeling High Chop
steps: Use a low anchor point.
Rotate your torso upward while exhaling through the contraction.
Keep the lower ribs low (avoid arching the back).
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Overhead Squat
steps: Stand on the band and keep your arms extended above your head.
Lower into a squat while continuing to push your arms straight up.
Make sure that the back remains straight.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Sandbag Shouldering
steps: Shoulder the sandbag in one explosive movement from the floor onto your shoulder.
Extend your hips forcefully into full lockout.
Drop in a controlled manner and switch sides.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Sandbag Get Up
steps: Lie on the floor with the bag on one shoulder (or chest).
Rise to a full standing position without using your hands if possible, or following the Turkish Get-Up technique.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Rotational Lunge
steps: Hold the bag in front of you (by the handles).
Step into a lunge while rotating the sandbag over your lead leg.
Decelerate the momentum and return under control to the start.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Sandbag Plank Drag
steps: Lie in a high plank with the bag next to you.
Reach under your torso in plank and pull the sandbag through to the opposite side.
Keep your hips square and motionless.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Sandbag Burpee
steps: Place the sandbag flat on the ground.
Drop into a full chest-to-floor burpee.
Jump up, grab the bag, do a Clean and possibly a Press above your head.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Sandbag Clean & Press
steps: Clean the sandbag explosively up to chest level.
From there you immediately push it forcefully above your head (Press).
Use your legs for momentum.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Sandbag Good Morning
steps: Hold the sandbag tightly against your chest in a bear hug or across your shoulders.
Hinge forward at your hips maintaining a slight bend in your knees.
Maintain a perfectly flat, neutral spine.
Feel the stretch in your hamstrings and drive your hips forward to stand.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Sandbag Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent.
Place the sandbag across your hips for added resistance.
Drive your hips upward and squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
The bag provides extra resistance.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Sandbag Lunge
steps: Place the sandbag on the neck or hold it in front of the chest.
Do lunges.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Bear Hug Carry
steps: Clamp the sandbag tightly against your chest and torso in a bear hug.
Walk upright with tall posture and a braced core.
Maintain continuous hold without letting the sandbag drop.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Sandbag Bent Over Row
steps: Grip the sandbag handles or canvas fabric firmly.
Hinge forward maintaining a neutral spine and hips pushed back.
Pull the bag towards your navel/chest and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
cues: Lead the pull with your elbows and initiate with scapular retraction.
Avoid using excessive momentum or swinging your torso.

name: Sandbag Floor Press
steps: Lie on your back with the bag on your chest.
Press the sandbag straight overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower down until your triceps contact the ground.
cues: Maintain an active, braced core and steady breathing cadence.
Focus on quality of movement and full range of motion.

name: Sandbag Overhead Press
steps: Establish a strong, grounded athletic stance.
Press the sandbag straight overhead from chest level.
Push your head forward through the window formed by your arms as the sandbag clears your face.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Sandbag Deadlift
steps: Bend your knees and hips and grab the handles (or fabric).
Keep your back straight and your chest proud.
Lift the sandbag by driving through your legs with a flat spine.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Sandbag Russian Twist
steps: Sit down, feet off the floor.
Hold the bag and rotate your upper body from left to right.
Tap the ground next to you with the bag.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Sandbag Step Up
steps: Rest the sandbag across your upper back or over one shoulder.
Step onto a plyo box or bench and drive yourself upward.
Switch legs.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Sandbag High Pull
steps: Start in deadlift position.
Explosively pull the bag up along your body to chin height.
Keep your elbows pointing high and flared out.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Aero Position (Triathlon)
steps: Rest your forearms on the aero handlebars and clasp your hands together.
Keep your back horizontal and low.
Focus on maintaining a steady, consistent pedal cadence.
Good for long endurance stretches.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: De Hover
steps: Get out of the saddle, but stay low.
Keep the buttocks only a few centimeters above the point of the saddle.
Hands in position 2 or 3.
This greatly isolates the quadriceps.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Rapid Fire Jumps (2 Tellen)
steps: Stand for 2 seconds, sit for 2 seconds.
Recommended for advanced athletes only.
Requires a lot of core stability and good basic resistance.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Bear Crawl
steps: Start on all fours, then elevate your knees a couple of inches off the floor into a beast hold.
Crawl forward by moving your opposite hand and foot forward simultaneously in contralateral synchronization.
Keep your back flat (like a table) and hips low.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Broad Jumps (Ver-Springen)
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Swing your arms back and bend to your knees.
Jump explosively forward as far as possible.
Land softly on both feet, absorb the landing, and rebound into the next jump.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Carioca (Kruispas)
steps: Move sideways.
Cross your trailing leg alternately in front of and behind your lead leg in a carioca pattern.
Rotate your hips smoothly.
Extend your arms outward to assist with balance.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Inchworm
steps: Stand tall with upright posture.
Bend over and place your hands on the floor (legs as straight as possible).
Walk your hands forward along the floor until you reach a high plank position.
Then walk your feet towards your hands.
Repeat.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Lateral Shuffle
steps: Stand in a quarter squat, sideways on the track.
Shuffle sideways without crossing your feet ('connection step').
Stay low and keep your chest up.
Look forward.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Reverse Bear Crawl
steps: Start in a quadruped bear crawl position with knees hovering off the floor.
Now crawl back.
Push firmly into the floor through your palms.
Keep your hips low and stable.
This requires a lot of your shoulders and coordination.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Backward Sled Drag
steps: Attach a strap or rope to the sled.
Grip the handles and drop into an athletic quarter-squat facing the sled.
Walk backwards and pull the sled along.
Keep your back straight and your chest proud.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Sled Push (Prowler Push)
steps: Grip the high vertical handles of the prowler sled.
Lean forward aggressively maintaining a 45-degree body angle.
Drive the sled away powerfully by extending your legs fully.
Keep arms steady and generate all driving power from your legs.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Walking Lunges
steps: Take an exaggerated deep stride with one leg.
Drop your hips until your back knee hovers just above the ground without banging the floor.
Step directly forward into your next walking lunge.
Keep your torso tall and upright.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Farmer's Walk
steps: Hold a heavy kettlebell or dumbbell in each hand.
Walk across the track with short, quick steps.
Squeeze the handles hard, keeping your shoulders back and your core tight.
Avoid using swinging momentum to move the weights.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Suitcase Carry
steps: Hold a single heavy weight in one hand at your side like a suitcase.
Walk tall and upright across the track lane.
The primary objective is to resist lateral tilting and keep your hips perfectly square.
Tighten your oblique abdominal muscles to stay straight.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Overhead Carry
steps: Hold a weight plate or kettlebell overhead with locked arms.
Walk at a steady, controlled pace.
Tighten your abdominal muscles so that your back does not arch (ribs low).
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Duck Walk
steps: Lower into a deep squat.
Stay as low as possible and walk forward.
Keep your chest upright and try not to rise while walking.
Burns in the quadriceps!
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: B-Skips
steps: Same start as A-Skip (knee up), but extend your lower leg at the highest point and actively claw your foot back to the ground (pawing motion).
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Backpedal (Achteruit Rennen)
steps: Run backwards across the track.
Stay on your forefeet and lean slightly forward (nose above toes) to keep your balance.
Pump your arms along.
Look over your shoulder to see where you are going.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Plate Push
steps: Place a heavy weight plate flat onto the turf track.
Place your hands on the disc, arms extended.
Drive the weight plate across the track as fast as possible by driving hard through your legs in a sprint stance.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Crab Walk
steps: Sit down, place your hands behind you and feet flat.
Drive your hips upward into full extension.
Walk backwards (or forwards) on all fours with your stomach toward the ceiling.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: A-Skips
steps: Skip rhythmically while explosively driving one knee to hip height and pushing forcefully off your supporting leg.
Extend fully through your body and pump your arms.
'Tick-tock' rhythm.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Butt Kicks
steps: Run across the track and kick your butt with your heels.
Keep your knees pointed downward (not forward).
Keep a fast pace.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: High Knees
steps: Run around the track while pulling your knees up to hip height.
Keep your torso upright and pump your arms rhythmically.
Focus on a high rhythm and land on the balls of your feet.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Burpee Over Bag
steps: Lay the punching bag flat on the floor.
Perform a chest-to-floor burpee beside the heavy bag.
Come up and jump over the pole with both feet at the same time.
Immediately drop down into another burpee rep.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Lateral Jumps Over Bag
steps: Place the bag flat on the ground.
Stand next to it and jump sideways over the pole and back again.
Keep your feet together and stay light on your forefeet.
Ensure a soft landing.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Sprawl & Brawl
steps: Throw a crisp 1-2 punch combination into the heavy bag.
Immediately do a Sprawl (hips to the ground, legs wide back) without hitting the pole.
Jump up and immediately push further.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Bag Tackle & Reset (Omgooien & Rechtzetten)
steps: Tackle the freestanding bag driving it to the floor (ensure surrounding clearance!).
Push yourself up immediately, grab the punching bag in a squat stance, and lift it explosively back upright.
Repeat this.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Ground & Pound (Mount)
steps: Lay the pole flat.
Sit astride the pole (Mount position).
Lock your knees and hit the pole with your left and right.
Alternate between punches and sharp elbow strikes.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Jab - Cross (1-2 Combo)
steps: Get into a fighting stance.
Throw a quick lead jab followed immediately by a powerful rear cross.
Rotate your hips for power.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Jab - Cross - Hook
steps: Throw a jab-cross combination and follow immediately with a lead hook.
Keep your elbow high at the corner and protect your chin with your other hand.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Clinch Knees
steps: Grip the top of the punching bag with both hands in a Muay Thai clinch.
Pull the bag in slightly and drive a powerful knee strike into the center of the bag.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Roundhouse Kicks (Lichaam)
steps: Deliver a powerful roundhouse kick into the midsection of the heavy bag.
Hit the pole with your shin.
Pump your arm along with the movement to generate rotational momentum.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Front Kicks (Teep)
steps: Chamber your knee and thrust the ball of your foot forward into the bag in a front teep kick.
Use this to push the pole (or opponent) away from you.
Keep your hands up in a protective boxing guard.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Uppercuts
steps: Stand close to the pole.
Throw crisp, short uppercuts driving from the legs and hips upward.
Use your legs to generate force (small squat movement).
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Combo: Jab-Cross-Low Kick
steps: Throw a crisp jab-cross combination at head height.
Follow up immediately with a hard rear low kick into the base of the bag.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Switch Kicks
steps: Switch stance rapidly in a switch-step and deliver a rear kick into the bag.
Speed ​​is key.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Superman Punch
steps: Pretend to kick with your back leg, but kick that leg back as you lunge forward and deliver a straight punch.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Spinning Back Kick
steps: Turn your back to the pole, look over your shoulder and kick straight back into the pole with your heel.
Make sure you look where you're kicking before straightening your leg.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Body Shots (Hooks)
steps: Bend your knees slightly and punch hard angles into the side of the pole (at the level of the liver/ribs).
Alternate left and right.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Freestyle Blitz (All-Out)
steps: Over time (e.g.
30 sec) deliver non-stop punches, kicks and knees as fast and hard as you can.
Focus on speed and endurance.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Low Kicks
steps: Step out diagonally with your lead leg and strike the lower-mid bag with your shin in a low kick.
Fully rotate your hip.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Elbow Strikes
steps: Come close.
Turn your body and hit the bar horizontally or diagonally with the tip of your elbow.
Hold your other hand tightly against your head.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Sit-up Punches
steps: Lie on the ground in front of the pole (feet towards the pole).
Perform a sit-up and give two punches (1-2) at the top of the side or base of the pole.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Tyre Box Squat
steps: Stand in front of the band.
Squat down until your glutes tap the tire, then explode upward to standing.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Tyre Sledgehammer
steps: Hit the tire with a sledgehammer.
Be cautious of the elastic recoil and maintain firm control.
Switch lead stance (orthodox to southpaw).
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Tyre Decline Push Up
steps: Feet on the tire, hands on the ground.
Perform a full range-of-motion push-up.
Heavier for the top of the chest.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Tyre Flips
steps: Drop into a deep squat and wedge your hands firmly under the tire edge.
Lift from the legs (not the back!) and push the band forward to flip it over.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Tyre Jumps (Box Jump)
steps: Jump onto the tire with both feet and land softly.
Drive your hips into full extension.
Step or jump down under control.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Tyre Bear Hug Squats
steps: Lift the band (if it is not too heavy) and hold it against your chest.
Perform standard squats.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Tyre Military Press
steps: Press the resistance band overhead to full lockout in a shoulder press.
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.

name: Tyre Squat Press
steps: Hold the band at chest height, squat and push out upwards.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Tyre Toe Taps
steps: Tap the edge of the band alternately with your toes.
Maintain a rapid tempo with light, bouncy skips.
cues: Brace your core tightly as if preparing for a punch and avoid arching the lower back.
Exhale forcefully through pursed lips during the concentric contraction.

name: Tyre Lateral Jumps (Into Tyre)
steps: Stand beside the tire or treadmill.
Jump laterally into the center of the tire and back out.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Tyre Burpee Jump
steps: Do a burpee for the band.
Instead of jumping straight up, jump both feet simultaneously onto the treadmill belt.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: Tyre Elevated Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back on the floor, feet on the band.
Drive your hips upward into full extension.
cues: Keep your chest lifted and push through the midfoot and heel.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.

name: TRX Atomic Push Up
steps: Place your feet into the suspension foot straps.
Perform a push-up and then immediately pull your knees under your chest (Knee Tuck).
cues: Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a stable, braced upper back.
Control the eccentric lowering phase without flaring elbows excessively.
